entries.result: Always call `inspect_first_y4m_frame` on Y4M, MP4, and Matroska inputs in `validate_video_packet_budget_with_geometry_interval_and_limit` (`src/native_export.rs`) regardless of `options.max_packet_bytes`, and reject empty `[from, to)` presentation intervals on Y4M, non-reordered MP4, and non-reordered Matroska inputs with `"input has no decoded video frames"`. Five focused integration tests, 12 related tests across 3 suites, and 1 offline fixture unit test pass.

entries.title: Validate first-frame presence, spatial geometry, and pixel filter plane compatibility in native_plan::transcode_lossless across Y4M, Matroska, and MP4 inputs
entries.before: native_plan::transcode_lossless (`src/native_plan.rs`) checks only container eligibility (`native_lossless::eligible`) and filter syntax (`native_lossless::configuration`), without inspecting the first video frame or validating `VideoGeometry` and `PixelFilters` against actual frame dimensions, stored crop/rotation, or chroma subsampling. Consequently, calling `plan_transcode_lossless` with default `CopyOptions` accepts 0-frame Y4M inputs (`zero-frames-8x4.y4m`), out-of-bounds crop rectangles, odd chroma crop dimensions on 4:2:0 video, and undersized pad canvases across Y4M, Matroska, and MP4 sources that fail at execution time in `transcode_lossless`.
entries.result: Add `native_lossless_y4m::validate_first_frame` (`src/native_lossless_y4m.rs`) and `native_lossless::validate_first_mp4_frame` (`src/native_lossless.rs`) and invoke them from `native_plan::transcode_lossless` (`src/native_plan.rs`) so planning validates first-frame presence, spatial geometry, and pixel filter compatibility with the exact same diagnostics as execution. Four focused integration tests, 6 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Route CLI media decode with shuffleframes, reverse, and input-format through owned decode and reject zero-frame decodes and lossless Y4M plans
entries.before: In default builds without `--features media`, `fvid media decode` (`src/media_cli.rs`) strips only `--framestep` and spatial/pixel filters before `plain_decode`, so passing `--shuffleframes`, `--reverse`, or `--input-format` falls through to `"this media operation requires cargo build --release --features media"` even though `fvid::media::decode_video_transformed` already owns them across Y4M, Matroska, and MP4. In addition, `owned_y4m_decode::decode_reader_transformed` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_y4m_decode.rs`) and `owned_video_decode::decode_webm` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_video_decode.rs`) return `Ok(DecodeStats { video_frames: 0, .. })` on 0-frame inputs or when `--framestep`/`--shuffleframes`/`--reverse` drops all frames, and `owned_lossless::plan_transcode_lossless` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_lossless.rs`) under default `CopyOptions` skips checking whether a Y4M source contains at least one frame.
entries.result: Add `try_owned_decode_command` in `src/media_cli.rs` to route `fvid media decode` with `--shuffleframes`, `--reverse`, `--input-format`, and all owned `DecodeTransform` flags through `fvid::media::decode_video_transformed`, reject `consumed == 0` or 0-emitted-frame temporal filter decodes in `owned_y4m_decode::decode_reader_transformed` and `owned_video_decode::decode_webm` with `"input has no decoded video frames"`, and verify first-frame presence in `owned_lossless::plan_transcode_lossless` on Y4M sources under default `CopyOptions`. Five focused integration tests, 22 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Validate post-compositing pixel filters against post-geometry frames in native overlay and decode-overlay planning and record rotate in CLI overlay geometry plan steps
entries.before: `TimedOverlay::validate_pair_with_geometry` (`src/native_export/overlay.rs`), `overlay_with_geometry` (`src/native_plan.rs`), and `decode_overlay_with_geometry` (`src/native_plan.rs`) validate only main/foreground geometry and colour/aspect/subsampling compatibility without applying or validating post-compositing `PixelFilters`. As a result, `fvid media plan overlay` and `fvid media plan decode --overlay` (`src/media_cli.rs`) accept incompatible pixel filters (such as oversized `boxblur` radius `lr=10` on 8x4 YUV420 or `deband` with `coupling=1` on 4:2:0) that fail at execution time, and `try_owned_overlay` in `src/media_cli.rs` omits `rotate` from the `geometry` plan step detail for `plan overlay`.
entries.result: Add `TimedOverlay::validate_pair_with_geometry_and_filters` (`src/native_export/overlay.rs`), `overlay_with_geometry_and_filters` and `decode_overlay_with_geometry_and_filters` (`src/native_plan.rs`), and wire them through `native_plan::transcode_lossless` and `try_owned_overlay` (`src/media_cli.rs`), while including `rotate` in the `plan overlay` geometry step detail. Six focused integration tests, 9 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Update native decode pixel_format and Y4M export preflight packet budget after cross-plane shuffleplanes subsampling promotion and reject --rotate in CLI crop-lossless fallback
entries.before: In `decode_video_pipeline_overlay_step` (`src/native_media.rs`), `stats.pixel_format` is updated for `geometry.transpose` but is not recomputed from `output.subsampling` after `filters.apply_colour_clock(...)`. When cross-plane `shuffleplanes` (e.g. `"1:2:0"`) promotes a 4:2:0 or 4:2:2 frame to 4:4:4 (`Some([1, 1])`), `fvid::native_media::decode_video_request` and `fvid media decode` report `"yuv420p"` instead of `"yuv444p"`. In addition, `export_y4m_sources_with_options` (`src/native_export.rs`) validates the Y4M output frame byte budget with `inspect_first_y4m_frame(source, geometry)` without `filters`, so a promoted 4:4:4 Y4M frame (96 bytes on 8x4 vs 48 bytes raw 4:2:0) bypasses preflight `--max-packet-bytes` validation; and the CLI `crop-lossless` fallback check (`src/media_cli.rs`) omits `(geometry.rotate.is_some(), "--rotate")` and `filters.canonicalize_option_order()`.
entries.result: Recompute `pixel_format` from `output.subsampling` after `filters.apply_colour_clock(...)` in `decode_video_pipeline_overlay_step` (`src/native_media.rs`), add `inspect_first_y4m_frame_with_filters` and `validate_video_packet_budget_with_geometry_filters_interval_and_limit` (`src/native_export.rs`) and call them in `export_y4m_sources_with_options`, and reject `--rotate` alongside `--scale`/`--transpose`/`--pad` in the `crop-lossless` fallback check (`src/media_cli.rs`). Seven focused integration tests, 9 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Validate first-frame geometry and pixel filters on Y4M inputs in owned_lossless::plan_transcode_lossless under default packet budgets
entries.before: In `owned_lossless::plan_transcode_lossless` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_lossless.rs`), when `options` uses default packet limits (`options.max_packets.is_none()` and default `options.max_packet_bytes`) and no temporal filter (`interval`, `framestep`, `shuffleframes`, `reverse`) is active, the Y4M planning branch only reads two lines (`header` and `FRAME\n`) and skips validating `requested_geometry`, `overlay`, and `apply_pixel_filters_clock` on the first frame. Consequently, calling `plan_transcode_lossless` on a Y4M source with metadata or stream-selection options (e.g. `--metadata title=test`) or on a default-FPS Y4M source without an explicit `F` header token accepts out-of-bounds `--crop` rectangles and oversized `--boxblur` radii that fail at execution time.
entries.result: Validate the first transformed Y4M frame through `visit_reader_transformed_counted` in the default-packet-budget branch of `owned_lossless::plan_transcode_lossless` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_lossless.rs`), and remove the duplicate `transform.unsharp.is_some()` guard in `owned_y4m_decode::apply_pixel_filters_clock` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_y4m_decode.rs`). Eight focused integration tests, 8 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Scan ADTS packets and include Matroska packet-budget step in native_plan::remux_with_options and route CLI plan transcode --encoder ffv1 and shorthand plan INPUT in default builds
entries.before: In `native_plan::remux_with_options` (`src/native_plan.rs`), ADTS inputs only inspect the first 8-byte signature via `native_probe::probe` without scanning packets through `container::adts::StreamReader`, and Matroska inputs omit the `budget` plan step (`FVid maximum encoded packet size: N bytes`) that `fvid::media::plan_remux` (`src/media.rs`) appends manually. As a result, `fvid::native_plan::remux` and `fvid media plan remux` accept ADTS files with truncated or corrupt packets after the first frame and produce Matroska remux plans that diverge from `fvid::media::plan_remux`. In addition, `src/media_cli.rs` rewrites `fvid media transcode INPUT OUTPUT --encoder ffv1` to `transcode-lossless` in default builds without `--features media`, but does not rewrite `fvid media plan transcode INPUT --encoder ffv1` or shorthand `fvid media plan INPUT [--crop ...]`.
entries.result: Scan ADTS packets with `container::adts::StreamReader::open_with_packet_limit` and include the Matroska `budget` step directly in `native_plan::remux_with_options` (`src/native_plan.rs`), unify default-option ADTS and Matroska planning in `fvid::media::plan_remux` (`src/media.rs`), and route `fvid media plan transcode INPUT --encoder ffv1` and shorthand `fvid media plan INPUT` in `src/media_cli.rs` in default builds without `--features media`. Five focused integration tests, 11 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Reject encoder selection on CLI media plan and reject duplicate or unknown options on CLI overlay and plan overlay
entries.before: In default builds without `--features media`, `src/media_cli.rs` rewrites `fvid media plan transcode INPUT --encoder ffv1` and shorthand `fvid media plan INPUT` without first enforcing `run_native`'s rule that `fvid media plan` rejects `--encoder`, `--encoder-option`, and shorthand metadata-mutation flags (`--metadata`, `--metadata-delete`, `--stream-metadata`, `--stream-metadata-delete`) with `"plan does not take metadata mutation or encoder selection"`. In addition, `try_owned_overlay` (`src/media_cli.rs`) silently overwrites earlier `--overlay`, `--overlay-x`, and `--overlay-y` flags when repeated and returns `Ok(false)` on unknown `--...` flags, causing `fvid media overlay` and `fvid media plan overlay` to fall through to `"this media operation requires cargo build --release --features media"` instead of reporting `"unsupported overlay option: ..."`.
entries.result: Reject `--encoder` and `--encoder-option` on `fvid media plan` and reject metadata mutation flags on shorthand `fvid media plan INPUT` in `src/media_cli.rs` with `"plan does not take metadata mutation or encoder selection"`, and reject duplicate `--overlay`, `--overlay-x`, and `--overlay-y` flags and unknown `--...` flags in `try_owned_overlay` (`src/media_cli.rs`) with explicit diagnostic errors. Nine focused integration tests, 20 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Validate positional path arity and flag-prefixed destinations in owned lossless, xfade, and burn-subtitles CLI commands and ignore --progress across owned plan subcommands
entries.before: In `src/media_cli.rs`, `owned_lossless_command_with_name`, `owned_xfade_command`, `owned_subtitle_burn_command`, and the native `transcode-lossless` / `crop-lossless` fast path index positional paths (`args[1..required]`) without checking whether a flag (`--quiet`, `--crop`, etc.) appears where a destination path is required or whether extra positional paths appear after `args[required..]`. Consequently, `fvid media transcode-lossless INPUT --quiet` treats `--quiet` as the destination path `args[2]` and writes a Matroska file literally named `--quiet` in the current working directory, while extra positional arguments (`INPUT OUTPUT EXTRA`) return `Ok(false)` and fall through to `"this media operation requires cargo build --release --features media"`. In addition, `plan remux`, `plan normalize-loudness`, `plan trim`, `plan trim-pcm`, `plan mix-audio`, `plan merge-audio`, and `plan concat` reject `--progress` instead of ignoring it during planning like `run_native` and `plan transcode-lossless`.
entries.result: Validate positional path arity and reject `-`-prefixed positional slots or extra positional arguments in `owned_lossless_command_with_name`, `owned_xfade_command`, `owned_subtitle_burn_command`, and the native `transcode-lossless`/`crop-lossless` fast path (`src/media_cli.rs`), and accept and ignore `--progress` during planning across `plan remux`, `plan normalize-loudness`, `plan trim`, `plan trim-pcm`, `plan mix-audio`, `plan merge-audio`, and `plan concat`. Ten focused integration tests, 20 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Support optional destination path and destination-specific metadata validation in CLI plan loudnorm and enforce positional path arity in owned_loudnorm_cli
entries.before: In `owned_loudnorm_cli::run` and `owned_loudnorm_cli::run_plan` (`src/owned_loudnorm_cli.rs`) and `run_native` (`src/media_cli.rs`), `fvid media plan loudnorm` rejects an optional destination path `INPUT [OUTPUT.wav|OUTPUT.mka|OUTPUT.mkv]` (`"unsupported loudnorm plan option: planned-out.mka"`), unlike `fvid media plan normalize-loudness INPUT [OUTPUT.wav|OUTPUT.mka|OUTPUT.mkv]`. Consequently, callers cannot validate destination-specific rules during `plan loudnorm` (such as rejecting `--stream-metadata` or non-RIFF-INFO container keys when the planned destination is `.wav`, or rejecting unsupported output extensions like `.mp3`). In addition, `owned_loudnorm_cli::run` and `run_plan` index `args[1]` and `args[2]` without checking whether a `--...` flag occupies a required positional slot or whether extra positional paths appear.
entries.result: Parse positional paths and flags cleanly in `owned_loudnorm_cli::run` and `owned_loudnorm_cli::run_plan` (`src/owned_loudnorm_cli.rs`) and `run_native` (`src/media_cli.rs`), accept an optional destination path `INPUT [OUTPUT.wav|OUTPUT.mka|OUTPUT.mkv]` in `plan loudnorm`, and validate the destination extension (`.wav`, `.mka`, `.mkv`) and `.wav` RIFF INFO metadata constraints before planning or executing loudnorm. Two focused integration tests, 4 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Separate container route qualification from packet-budget enforcement in native_loudnorm::try_plan and try_apply
entries.before: In `native_loudnorm::try_plan` (`src/native_loudnorm.rs:233-237`) and `native_loudnorm::try_apply` (`src/native_loudnorm.rs:526-529`), route qualification passes `options` (including `max_packet_bytes` and `max_packets`) into `is_owned_audio_trim_source_with_options` and `audio_source_info_selected_with_options(...).is_ok()`. When a caller configures a tight packet byte budget (`max_packet_bytes: 1`) on a multi-track MP4 container without an explicit `--streams` selection (`tests/fixtures/playback-errors/alac-two-tracks.m4a`), `audio_source_info_selected_with_options` fails with `"MP4 packet exceeds budget"`, which causes `.is_ok()` to evaluate to `false` and `try_plan`/`try_apply` to fall through to `owned_container_loudnorm::supports_plan` (which returns `false` on multi-track MP4 without explicit stream selection) and return `Ok(None)` instead of propagating `Err("MP4 packet exceeds budget")`.
entries.result: Qualify native container and codec eligibility in `native_loudnorm::try_plan` and `native_loudnorm::try_apply` (`src/native_loudnorm.rs`) using default packet limits while preserving stream selection and cancellation, so subsequent execution and plan checks propagate `"MP4 packet exceeds budget"` and `"WebM packet exceeds budget"` errors cleanly instead of returning `Ok(None)`. Nine focused integration tests in `tests/native_loudnorm_cli.rs`, 5 related tests across 4 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Allow controlled memory budgets alongside Matroska metadata mutations in decode_audio and trim and support destination-aware CLI planning for decode-audio and trim
entries.before: In `decode_fvid_media_audio_to_destination` (`src/media.rs:237-242`) and `plan_decode_audio` (`src/media.rs:452-456`), validating Matroska container or stream 0 metadata mutations calls `validate_owned_audio_options_for_destination(options, ...)`, which rejects `options.max_controlled_bytes.is_some()` with `"native audio does not yet support requested allocation budget or metadata/stream mutations"` even though `fvid_media::decode_audio_transformed` and `fvid_media::plan_decode_audio` enforce `max_controlled_bytes`. In addition, `fvid media plan decode-audio`, `fvid media plan trim`, and `fvid media plan trim-pcm` (`src/media_cli.rs`) reject an optional destination path (`"unsupported native audio plan option: planned-out.mka"`) and cannot validate destination-specific metadata constraints during planning, while `fvid media decode-audio` falls through to `"this media operation requires cargo build --release --features media"` in default builds when given an unsupported output extension, missing output path, or unknown flag.
entries.result: Clear `max_controlled_bytes` on the Matroska metadata preflight copy in `decode_fvid_media_audio_to_destination` and `plan_decode_audio` (`src/media.rs`) while retaining `max_controlled_bytes` during `fvid_media::decode_audio_transformed` and `fvid_media::plan_decode_audio`, and update `plan decode-audio`, `decode-audio`, and `try_native_audio_trim` (`src/media_cli.rs`) to accept flags and positional paths in any order, accept an optional destination path on `plan decode-audio`, `plan trim`, and `plan trim-pcm` with destination-specific metadata and extension validation, and report direct CLI errors on invalid `decode-audio` invocations. Two focused integration tests, 16 related tests across 3 suites, and 1 offline fixture unit test pass.

entries.title: Support destination-aware CLI planning and flexible argument ordering in plan remux, remux, plan loudness, and loudness
entries.before: In `media_cli::run` and `media_cli::run_native` (`src/media_cli.rs`), `plan remux`, `remux`, `plan loudness`, and `loudness` assume fixed positional indexing (`args[1]` / `args[2]`), so passing flags before positional paths (`fvid media plan remux --quiet INPUT`, `fvid media plan loudness --quiet INPUT`, `fvid media loudness --quiet INPUT`) or omitting `INPUT` treats the flag as a path or fails with `"unsupported remux plan option"`. In addition, `plan remux` rejects an optional destination path `INPUT [OUTPUT.wav|OUTPUT.mp4|OUTPUT.m4a|OUTPUT.mka|OUTPUT.mkv]` and cannot validate destination-specific metadata constraints (`.wav` rejecting stream metadata or non-RIFF-INFO keys, `.mp4`/`.m4a` rejecting metadata mutations), and `fvid media remux` with an unsupported output extension (`bad.mp3`) or missing output path falls through to `"this media operation requires cargo build --release --features media"` in default builds.
entries.result: Update `plan remux`, `remux`, `plan loudness`, and `loudness` in `media_cli::run` and `media_cli::run_native` (`src/media_cli.rs`) to accept flags and positional paths in any order, accept an optional destination path on `plan remux` with destination-specific extension and metadata validation, and report direct CLI errors on invalid `remux`, `plan remux`, `loudness`, and `plan loudness` invocations. Five focused integration tests, 13 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Support flexible argument ordering and destination-aware metadata validation in CLI concat and plan concat
entries.before: In `try_native_audio_concat`, `try_video_concat`, and `try_mp4_matroska_concat` (`src/media_cli.rs`), CLI `concat` and `plan concat` assume fixed positional indexing (`args[command + 1]` / `args[command + 2]`), so passing flags before positional paths (`fvid media plan concat --quiet --max-packets 2 a.wav b.wav`, `fvid media concat --quiet out.wav a.wav b.wav`) fails with `No such file or directory (os error 2)` or returns `Ok(false)` and falls through to `"this media operation requires cargo build --release --features media"` in default builds. In addition, `concat` and `plan concat --output-format wav` do not preflight destination-specific metadata constraints (`.wav` rejecting stream metadata or non-RIFF-INFO container keys, `.mp4`/`.m4a` rejecting metadata mutations), and `concat` with an unsupported output extension (`bad.mp3`), fewer than two inputs, or an unknown flag falls through to the feature-gate error.
entries.result: Update `try_native_audio_concat`, `try_video_concat`, and `try_mp4_matroska_concat` (`src/media_cli.rs`) to parse positional paths and flags in any order, validate destination extensions and `.wav` / `.mp4` / `.m4a` metadata constraints on `concat` and `plan concat`, and report direct CLI errors on missing inputs, unsupported output extensions, or unknown concat flags in default builds. Five focused integration tests, 13 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Preserve packet-budget, extension, and option validation diagnostics in CLI mix-audio, merge-audio, convert-subtitles, and plan convert-subtitles
entries.before: In `native_mix` and `native_merge` (`src/media_cli.rs:5819-5960`), when `eligible_with_options(sources, &limits)` returns `false` (for example under `--max-packet-bytes 1` or when an unsupported destination extension like `.mp3` is given) and the destination extension is not `.wav` (e.g. `.mka` or `.mkv`), `native_mix` and `native_merge` return `Ok(false)` and fall through to `"this media operation requires cargo build --release --features media"` in default builds instead of delegating to `fvid::media::mix_audio_with_controls` / `merge_audio_with_controls` to report the specific packet-budget or output-extension error. Unknown flags (`--bogus`) in `native_mix` and `native_merge` similarly return `Ok(false)`. In addition, `convert-subtitles` and `plan convert-subtitles` (`src/media_cli.rs:606-767`) require `args.len() >= 3` and fall through to the feature-gate error on missing positional paths or unknown execution flags, and `run_native` `Some("convert-subtitles")` discards the optional destination path `plan_paths.get(1)` instead of validating `.mkv` output.
entries.result: Remove the premature `!native_eligible` `Ok(false)` bailout in `native_mix` and `native_merge`, reject unknown `mix-audio` and `merge-audio` flags directly, remove the `args.len() >= 3` gate on `convert-subtitles` and `plan convert-subtitles` in `media_cli::run`, and add `fvid::media::plan_convert_subtitles_for_destination` (`src/media.rs`) so both default and `media`-enabled builds validate the optional `.mkv` destination path during `plan convert-subtitles`. Three focused integration tests, 10 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Enforce .y4m destination extension in export_y4m_pipeline_with_options and support flexible flag ordering and direct diagnostics in export-y4m, transcode-lossless, crop-lossless, xfade, and burn-subtitles CLI
entries.before: In `fvid::native_export::export_y4m_pipeline_with_options` (`src/native_export.rs:69-90`), the destination path extension is not checked for `.y4m`, so calling `export_y4m_pipeline_with_options` or `fvid media export-y4m` with `out.mkv` writes raw Y4M bytes into a `.mkv` file instead of rejecting non-`.y4m` outputs as `concat_y4m_with_options` and `trim_y4m_with_options` do. In addition, `export-y4m` (`src/media_cli.rs:1515-1592`), `owned_lossless_command_with_name` (`transcode-lossless` / `crop-lossless`), `owned_xfade_command` (`xfade`), and `owned_subtitle_burn_command` (`burn-subtitles`) assume fixed positional argument indices (`args[1]` / `args[2]`), so leading flags (`fvid media export-y4m --quiet --boxblur luma_radius=1:chroma_radius=0 in.y4m out.y4m`, `fvid media plan transcode-lossless --quiet --hflip in.y4m`, `fvid media plan xfade --quiet --xfade-duration 0.04 a.y4m b.y4m`, `fvid media plan burn-subtitles --quiet --subs sub.srt in.y4m`) fail, and invocations with too few arguments or unknown flags on `crop-lossless`, `xfade`, and `burn-subtitles` return `Ok(false)` and fall through to `"this media operation requires cargo build --release --features media"` in default builds.
entries.result: Require `.y4m` output extensions in `export_y4m_pipeline_with_options` (`src/native_export.rs`), resolve the first non-flag decode input path in `pixel_decode_args`, and update `export-y4m`, `owned_lossless_command_with_name`, `owned_xfade_command`, and `owned_subtitle_burn_command` (`src/media_cli.rs`) to accept flags and positional paths in any order and report direct CLI errors on missing positional paths or unknown options in default builds. Eleven focused integration tests, 9 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Support flexible flag ordering in video trim CLI and preserve WAVE decode routing and direct diagnostics in audio trim CLI
entries.before: In `try_video_trim` (`src/media_cli.rs:5691-5796`), Y4M `trim` and `plan trim` assume fixed positional argument indices (`args[command + 1]` and `args[command + 2]`), so passing flags before positional paths (`fvid media plan trim --quiet --output-format y4m --from 0 --to 0.08 in.y4m`, `fvid media trim --quiet --from 0 --to 0.08 in.y4m out.y4m`) fails with `"unsupported native video trim option"` or returns `Ok(false)`. In addition, in `try_native_audio_trim` (`src/media_cli.rs:1766-1797`) missing positional arguments or unsupported destination extensions (`bad.mp3`) on `trim`, `trim-pcm`, `plan trim`, and `plan trim-pcm` return `Ok(false)` and fall through to `"this media operation requires cargo build --release --features media"` in default builds, and `fvid::media::trim` (`src/media.rs:664`) excludes `"wav"` from the `decode_fvid_media_audio_to_destination` branch when non-WAVE container audio is trimmed to `.wav`.
entries.result: Update `try_video_trim` (`src/media_cli.rs`) to accept flags and positional paths in any order, update `try_native_audio_trim` (`src/media_cli.rs`) to report direct CLI errors on missing positional paths or unsupported output extensions, and include `"wav"` in the non-WAVE `decode_fvid_media_audio_to_destination` branch of `fvid::media::trim` (`src/media.rs`). Five focused integration tests, 15 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Route WAVE-to-.f32le trim with custom budgets through controlled audio decoding and preflight destination metadata constraints in CLI decode-audio
entries.before: In `fvid::media::trim` (`src/media.rs:684`) and `try_native_audio_trim` (`src/media_cli.rs:1915`), when trimming a WAVE source with `max_controlled_bytes` (`--max-memory-mib`) or custom packet budgets, only `.mka` and `.mkv` destinations are routed through `decode_fvid_media_audio_to_destination`, while `.f32le` destinations fall through to `trim_pcm` and fail with `"owned WAVE remux requires .wav output"`. In addition, CLI `decode-audio` (`src/media_cli.rs:1478`) does not preflight destination-specific metadata constraints (`.f32le` rejecting metadata mutations, `.wav` rejecting stream metadata mutations and non-RIFF-INFO container keys) before invoking `decode_audio_transformed`.

In addition, `is_single_stream_fvid_media_audio_with_options` and `eligible_with_options` (`src/native_audio_mix.rs`) and `selected_audio` (`src/native_loudnorm.rs`) called `crate::media::probe` / `crate::native_probe::probe` without `options`, and `mix_audio_with_controls`, `merge_audio_with_controls` (`src/native_audio_mix.rs`), and `native_loudnorm::try_apply` (`src/native_loudnorm.rs`) called `extract_source_pcm_metadata_with_packet_limit` without forwarding `max_controlled_bytes` when writing `.mka`/`.mkv` outputs.
entries.result: Copy `options.max_controlled_bytes` into `default_probe` and call `crate::native_probe::probe_with_options(source, &geom_probe)` in `validate_concat_segments_with_options` (`src/native_audio_mix/concat.rs`), use `try_probe_as_with_options` / `probe_with_options` in `is_single_stream_fvid_media_audio_with_options`, `eligible_with_options` (`src/native_audio_mix.rs`), and `selected_audio` (`src/native_loudnorm.rs`), and call `extract_source_pcm_metadata_with_interval_packet_and_memory_limit` with `max_controlled_bytes` in `mix_audio_with_controls`, `merge_audio_with_controls`, and `native_loudnorm::try_apply`. Nine integration tests in `mp4_audio_metadata_admission` and nine in `mp4_metadata_admission` pass.

entries.title: Propagate controlled-memory Matroska packet-index and MP4 metadata ceilings across owned_webm_probe::probe_webm_with_packet_and_memory_limit, owned_remux_plan::plan_remux, native_plan::remux_with_options, and native_plan::concat_mp4_matroska_with_options
entries.before: In `owned_webm_probe::try_probe_webm_with_packet_limit` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_webm_probe.rs`), `WebmReader::open` and `scan_all()` used `Limits::default().packets` without a `max_controlled_bytes` parameter, and `owned_remux_plan::plan_remux` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_remux_plan.rs`) and `native_plan::remux_with_options` (`src/native_plan.rs`) called `probe_webm_with_packet_limit` / `matroska_with_packet_limit` with `options.max_packet_bytes.min(options.max_controlled_bytes.unwrap_or(usize::MAX))` and `native_probe::probe(source)` without `options`, while `native_plan::concat_mp4_matroska_with_options` called `crate::media::probe` / `crate::native_probe::probe` without `options`.
entries.result: Add `probe_webm_with_packet_and_memory_limit` and `try_probe_webm_with_packet_and_memory_limit` in `crates/fvid-media/src/owned_webm_probe.rs` clamping `Limits::packets` to `max_controlled_bytes / size_of::<Packet>()` and mapping clamped packet-count refusals to `"controlled memory budget exceeded: Matroska packet index limit"`, and propagate `options` across `owned_remux_plan::plan_remux`, `native_plan::remux_with_options`, and `native_plan::concat_mp4_matroska_with_options`. entries.title: Propagate controlled-memory ceilings (max_controlled_bytes) across NativeReader::software in Y4M first-frame inspection, concat compatibility, and export/trim/concat execution, and across export_pcm_selected MP4 metadata and Matroska packet-index limits
entries.before: In `src/native_export.rs`, `inspect_first_y4m_frame_with_filters` and `export_y4m_sources_with_options` opened `NativeReader::software(BufReader::new(File::open(source)?), usize::MAX)` with an unbounded memory budget (`usize::MAX`) instead of `options.max_controlled_bytes`, and `validate_y4m_concat_compatibility` (`src/native_plan.rs:950`) and `validate_video_packet_budget_with_geometry_filters_interval_and_limit` called `inspect_first_y4m_frame_with_filters` and `y4m_segment_frame_upper_bound` without forwarding `options`. In addition, `export_audio_pcm_selected_with_controls` passed `options: None` into `export_pcm_selected`, which opened `Mp4Reader::open_indexed` and `WebmReader::open` with `Limits::default()` and called `extract_source_pcm_metadata_with_interval_and_packet_limit` without `max_controlled_bytes`.
entries.result: Add `inspect_first_y4m_frame_with_filters_and_options` and `validate_y4m_concat_compatibility_with_options` (`src/native_export.rs`), pass `options.max_controlled_bytes.unwrap_or(usize::MAX)` to `NativeReader::software` in `inspect_first_y4m_frame_with_filters_and_options` and `export_y4m_sources_with_options`, forward `options` to `y4m_segment_frame_upper_bound_with_options` and `validate_y4m_concat_compatibility_with_options` (`src/native_plan.rs`), and propagate `options` and `max_controlled_bytes` in `export_audio_pcm_selected_with_controls` and `export_pcm_selected`. entries.title: Propagate controlled-memory ceilings (max_controlled_bytes) to FFV1, AVC, HEVC, VP9, and AV1 codec decoders in owned_webm_codec::Decoder, owned_video_decode::decode_webm, and owned_mp4_video_decode::decode_presented, and to owned_probe::probe_with_options in plan_transcode_lossless and plan_burn_subtitles

entries.result: Add `Decoder::new_with_budget` in `crates/fvid-media/src/owned_webm_codec.rs` and pass `options.and_then(|o| o.max_controlled_bytes).unwrap_or(usize::MAX)` in `owned_video_decode::decode_webm`, `owned_webm_codec::presentation_durations`, and all four codec branches (`AvcDecoder`, `Av1Decoder`, `vp9_decoder::Decoder`, `HevcDecoder`) of `owned_mp4_video_decode::decode_presented`, and add `owned_probe::probe_with_options` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_probe.rs`) used by `plan_transcode_lossless` and `plan_burn_subtitles`. entries.title: Clamp ADTS StreamReader packet limits to max_controlled_bytes across ADTS decode, loudness, planning, and spatial routing, emit budget notes in owned WAVE plan_loudness, and forward CopyOptions to G.711 WAVE recognition in plan_trim and trim
entries.before: In `owned_adts_loudness::validate_header_configuration`, `owned_adts_loudness::validate_packet_budget`, `owned_adts_export::supports`, `owned_adts_export::decode_to_wave_with_rate`, `owned_audio_plan::source_descriptor_for_decode`, `owned_aac_export_routing::router_for_decode`, `owned_aac::stream::decode_adts_pcm`, and `owned_aac::stream::adts_prefix_info`, `StreamReader::open_with_packet_limit` was called with `options.max_packet_bytes` without clamping to `options.max_controlled_bytes` (`options.max_packet_bytes.min(options.max_controlled_bytes.unwrap_or(usize::MAX))`), allowing an explicit-layout ADTS frame (`channels == 0`, PCE in first packet) to allocate its first transport frame payload (`vec![0; configuration.frame_bytes - 7]`) above `max_controlled_bytes` before decoder admission ran. In addition, `owned_wave_loudness::plan_loudness` omitted the standard `encoded packet limit: ...; packet work limit: ...; controlled memory limit: ...; RSS limit: ...` note when non-default `CopyOptions` budgets were supplied, and `owned_wave_plan::plan_trim` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_wave_plan.rs:65`) and `owned_wave_remux::trim` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_wave_remux.rs:64`) passed `&CopyOptions::default()` instead of `options` to `owned_g711_wave_export::recognizes`.
entries.result: Clamp `StreamReader::open_with_packet_limit` to `options.max_packet_bytes.min(options.max_controlled_bytes.unwrap_or(usize::MAX))` across `owned_adts_loudness`, `owned_adts_export`, `owned_audio_plan`, `owned_aac_export_routing`, and `owned_aac::stream`, append the standard budget note in `owned_wave_loudness::plan_loudness`, and forward `options` to `owned_g711_wave_export::recognizes` in `owned_wave_plan::plan_trim` and `owned_wave_remux::trim`. Ten integration tests in `mp4_audio_metadata_admission` and eleven in `mp4_metadata_admission` pass.
entries.spatial_budget_test_followup: Zero-count baseline validation: keep the existing early ADTS packet refusal under a one-byte ceiling. The spatial working-set control now uses8192 bytes to reach that later stage; separate one-byte ADTS/MP4/Matroska and explicit-packet/planning controls preserve the tighter bounds. All original assertions remain,8 spatial tests and the original admission unit pass. A tentative production error-context reclassification was rejected by the existing contract and fully reverted. See evidence/spatial-budget-diagnostic/validation.json.

entries.title: Forward CopyOptions packet, count, and memory ceilings through owned_probe::probe_with_options across WAVE, Y4M, FLAC, MPEG, Ogg, and ADTS probes and preflight frame and mask budgets in owned_subtitle_burn::prepare and owned_video_decode::decode_webm
entries.before: In `crates/fvid-media/src/owned_probe.rs`, `probe_with_options` forwarded `options` only for MP4 and Matroska/WebM and fell back to `probe_as(path, None)` with default `CopyOptions` for WAVE (`LIST INFO` strings up to 1 MiB without checking `max_controlled_bytes`), Y4M, bare FLAC (`owned_flac_probe::probe_flac`), bare MPEG audio (`owned_mpeg_probe::probe_mpeg`), Ogg (`probe_ogg`), and ADTS (`probe_adts`). In addition, `owned_subtitle_burn::prepare` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_subtitle_burn.rs:16-85`) did not check whether Y4M `frame_len > options.max_packet_bytes` or `frame_len.saturating_add(width * height) > max_controlled_bytes` (or container visible `width * height * 2 > max_controlled_bytes`), causing `plan_burn_subtitles` to allocate `width * height` raster masks for all cues and `burn_subtitles` to open the output Matroska writer before checking frame/mask memory admission; and `owned_video_decode::decode_webm` called `process_frame_with_overlay` before checking whether `decoded.frame.data.len().saturating_add(overlay_frame_len)` exceeded `max_controlled_bytes`.
entries.result: Add `probe_wave_with_options`, `probe_ogg_with_options`, and `probe_adts_with_options` in `owned_probe.rs`, `probe_flac_with_options` in `owned_flac_probe.rs`, `probe_mpeg_with_options` in `owned_mpeg_probe.rs`, and `probe_y4m_with_options` in `owned_y4m_probe.rs` and wire them into `owned_probe::probe_with_options`, and enforce frame/mask packet and memory budgets up front in `owned_subtitle_burn::prepare` and before `process_frame_with_overlay` in `owned_video_decode::decode_webm`. Twelve integration tests in `mp4_metadata_admission` pass.

entries.title: Forward CopyOptions across native_probe::try_probe_as_with_options, extract_source_pcm_metadata_with_interval_packet_and_memory_limit, and decode_source_to_f32le_with_options for WAVE, Y4M, FLAC, MPEG, Ogg, and ADTS sources

entries.result: Forward `options` through `native_probe::try_probe_as_with_options` (`src/media_probe.rs`) into `probe_wave_with_options`, `try_y4m_with_options`, `probe_flac_with_options`, `probe_mpeg_with_options`, `probe_ogg_with_options`, and `probe_adts_with_options`, use `native_probe::probe_with_options` / `try_probe_as_with_options` in `extract_source_pcm_metadata_with_interval_packet_and_memory_limit` (`src/native_export/pcm_matroska.rs`), and propagate `max_controlled_bytes` in `decode_source_to_f32le_with_options` (`src/native_audio_mix.rs`). entries.title: Enforce three-frame working-set and pre-export packet/memory budgets in owned_xfade and clamp ADTS PCE bootstrap packet limits to max_packet_bytes and max_controlled_bytes in owned_concat, native_audio_mix::concat, and native_loudnorm
entries.before: In `crates/fvid-media/src/owned_xfade.rs`, `visit_y4m_counted` retains three decoded frame buffers simultaneously (`primary.current`, `secondary.current`, and `output = current.data.clone()`), but `plan_xfade` and `write_y4m_ffv1_counted` only checked `frame_len.saturating_mul(2) > limit`, and `export_y4m_ffv1_counted` opened the atomic Matroska output file before checking `frame_len > options.max_packet_bytes` or `frame_len.saturating_mul(3) > limit`. entries.title: Forward CopyOptions cancellation and packet-byte ceilings across WAVE loudnorm, loudness, and remux supports/recognizes checks, owned_loudnorm::plan_loudnorm WAVE probing, and trailing-segment geometry validation in validate_concat_segments_with_options

entries.before: UTF-8 BOM (\u{FEFF}) at the start of sidecar SRT/WebVTT/ASS files, Matroska S_TEXT/UTF8, S_TEXT/ASS, and S_TEXT/SSA blocks, or MP4 tx3g payloads prevented header/field recognition and leaked raw '\u{FEFF}' or full 9-field ASS metadata prefixes into visible subtitle cues.
entries.result: Strip leading and inline '\u{FEFF}' in subtitles::parse, plain, parse_srt, parse_webvtt, parse_ass, ass_block, and mp4_subtitles::decoded_text.

entries.title: Preserve opening and post-rewind/seek_to_sync(0) bitstream_colour() and bitstream_hdr() for Matroska single-layer and multilayer HEVC and AVC
entries.before: WebmVideoReader::open_with_hardware only populated open_signal for AV1, and webm_layered::Layered::reset cleared signal and hdr to default instead of restoring opening metadata, so Matroska AVC and single-layer/multilayer HEVC tracks with in-band SPS VUI or HDR SEI in packet 0 lost their colour/HDR signal before the first frame, after rewind(), and after seek_to_sync(0).
entries.result: Capture opening colour and HDR metadata from CodecPrivate and packet 0 for Matroska AVC, single-layer HEVC, and multilayer HEVC, and restore them on rewind() and seek_to_sync(0) without mutating live decoder CLVS state.

entries.title: Preserve opening and post-rewind bitstream_colour(), active_colour(), and bitstream_hdr() for MP4 in-band AVC and single-layer/multilayer/mixed HEVC
entries.before: SingleLayerMp4VideoReader::read_open_signal only inspected AV1, and SingleView/MixedHevc only inspected hvcC arrays without checking sample 0 or restoring initial metadata on reset(), so MP4 avc3 and single-layer/multilayer/mixed hev1 tracks carrying in-band SPS VUI or HDR SEI in sample 0 returned default colour/HDR at open and after rewind().
entries.result: Inspect sample 0 for in-band avc3 and hev1 across SingleLayerMp4VideoReader, SingleView, and MixedHevc (while keeping complete avc1/hvc1 metadata-only on open) and restore initial colour, signal, and HDR on rewind().

entries.title: Populate StreamInfo.profile and StreamInfo.level for Matroska V_MPEG4/ISO/AVC tracks in media probe
entries.before: Matroska probing hardcoded profile: None and level: None for all tracks in both owned_webm_probe.rs and media_probe.rs, even when V_MPEG4/ISO/AVC tracks carried a valid AVCDecoderConfigurationRecord in CodecPrivate.
entries.result: Extract AVC profile name and level from CodecPrivate via owned_avc::configuration_profile_level in both owned_webm_probe.rs and media_probe.rs, matching MP4 avc1/avc3 stream probing.

entries.title: Fallback to indexed block and packet-span duration for Matroska A_AC3 and A_EAC3 when Segment/Info/Duration is omitted
entries.before: WebmAudioReader::duration() returned early with endpoint.or(self.demuxer.duration_ns) for A_AC3 and A_EAC3 tracks and did not scan A_AC3 headers on open, returning None before EOF whenever Segment/Info/Duration was absent even when DefaultDuration, BlockDuration, or multi-packet timestamps defined the track duration.
entries.result: Scan headers on open for A_AC3 alongside A_EAC3 and fall through to the indexed DefaultDuration/BlockDuration and packet-span duration calculation when Segment/Info/Duration is absent and EOF has not yet been reached.

entries.title: Normalize Matroska Dolby and text subtitle codec names across owned_webm_probe, media_probe, and owned_codec_metadata
entries.before: owned_webm_probe left Matroska A_AC3, A_AC3/BSID9, A_AC3/BSID10, A_EAC3, S_TEXT/UTF8, S_TEXT/ASS, S_TEXT/SSA, S_TEXT/WEBVTT, S_TEXT/ASCII, and legacy S_UTF8/S_ASS/S_SSA codec IDs unmapped, and media_probe / owned_codec_metadata omitted S_TEXT/WEBVTT, S_TEXT/ASCII, and legacy S_UTF8/S_ASS/S_SSA.
entries.result: Map Matroska Dolby and text subtitle codec IDs to canonical names ('ac3', 'eac3', 'subrip', 'ass', 'ssa', 'webvtt') in owned_webm_probe.rs and media_probe.rs, and register 'webvtt' in owned_codec_metadata.rs.

entries.title: Support DefaultDuration fallback and S_TEXT/SSA / legacy codec IDs in Matroska subtitle conversion and planning
entries.before: owned_subtitle::try_convert_matroska_inner required per-packet BlockDuration (ignoring track DefaultDuration on SimpleBlock packets) and rejected S_TEXT/SSA, S_ASS, S_SSA, S_TEXT/ASCII, and S_UTF8 tracks.
entries.result: Fallback to track.default_duration_ns when per-packet duration_ns is absent, and support S_TEXT/SSA, S_ASS, S_SSA, S_TEXT/ASCII, and S_UTF8 in both subtitle conversion and planning while normalizing SSA Marked=N layer fields to integer ASS layers.

entries.title: Support S_TEXT/WEBVTT, S_TEXT/ASCII, and legacy S_UTF8/S_ASS/S_SSA tracks in WebmSubtitleReader
entries.before: WebmSubtitleReader only listed S_TEXT/UTF8, S_TEXT/ASS, and S_TEXT/SSA in TEXT_CODECS, ignoring embedded S_TEXT/WEBVTT, S_TEXT/ASCII, S_UTF8, S_ASS, and S_SSA tracks.
entries.result: Admit S_TEXT/WEBVTT, S_TEXT/ASCII, S_UTF8, S_ASS, and S_SSA in WebmSubtitleReader, provide human-readable SubtitleTrack::label() names, and strip embedded WebVTT cue identifier/timing headers before extracting plain cue text.

entries.title: Support custom [Events] Format: column order, case-insensitive Dialogue:, and \h hard space in ASS/SSA subtitle parsing
entries.before: subtitles::parse_ass required exact case-sensitive 'Dialogue:' prefixes and hardcoded Start/End/Text to columns 1, 2, and 9 regardless of the [Events] Format: declaration, and subtitles::plain left '\h' hard-space escapes as literal '\h' in rendered text.
entries.result: Honor custom [Events] Format: column positions and case-insensitive Dialogue: lines in subtitles::parse_ass, and convert '\h' to non-breaking space '\u{a0}' in subtitles::plain.

entries.title: Preserve container colr (nclx) primaries, transfer, and matrix when MP4 AVC or HEVC VUI reports unspecified code 2
entries.before: owned_mp4_video_decode unconditionally overwrote container_colour with AVC and HEVC VUI colour codes whenever colour_description_present_flag was set, clobbering explicit MP4 colr (nclx) values with 2 (Unspecified) when VUI left individual colour components unspecified.
entries.result: Retain non-zero container colr (nclx) primaries, transfer, and matrix in owned_mp4_video_decode whenever the corresponding AVC or HEVC VUI code is 2 (Unspecified), matching AV1 and player MP4 colour resolution.

entries.title: Preserve Matroska container Colour fallback when bitstream VUI/sequence header reports unspecified code 2 or omits colour description
entries.before: owned_video_decode::decode_webm fell back to (full_range, matrix, 0, 0) when frame_colour was None (dropping container primaries and transfer) and only replaced frame_colour components equal to 0, while owned_ffv1_export only replaced view.primaries == 0 and view.transfer == 0 without replacing code 2 (Unspecified) or view.matrix in VideoMetadata::colour.
entries.result: Fallback to container track.colour primaries, transfer, and matrix in owned_video_decode::decode_webm and owned_ffv1_export::export_processed whenever frame_colour is None or reports 0 or 2 (Unspecified).

entries.title: Treat H.273 unspecified code 2 as replaceable in ColourDescription::filled_with
entries.before: ColourDescription::filled_with only replaced components equal to 0 and treated code 2 (Unspecified) as an explicit statement, preventing container nclx/Colour and bitstream VUI/sequence header descriptions from cross-filling unspecified code 2.
entries.result: Replace mine == 2 when theirs != 0 in ColourDescription::filled_with and treat only non-{0,2} codes as stated triples for full_range inheritance.

entries.title: Preserve bitstream VUI colour and HDR10 SEI/OBU metadata in native_lossless::write_mp4_selected
entries.before: native_lossless::write_mp4_selected populated output Matroska TrackOptions.video colour and hdr strictly from MP4 container colr/mdcv/ccll boxes via mp4_matroska::plan, dropping in-band VUI colour and SEI 137/144 / AV1 metadata OBU HDR metadata.
entries.result: Write combined container+bitstream reader.colour() and reader.hdr() into output Matroska TrackOptions.video in native_lossless::write_mp4_selected, matching native_lossless_y4m.

entries.title: Support \h hard space, HTML tags, general {...} override blocks, SSA Marked=N, custom [Events] Format:, and inline WebVTT cue IDs in fvid_media::plain_subtitle and parse_subtitle_text
entries.before: fvid_media::plain_subtitle left '\h', HTML tags, and non-backslash '{...}' blocks in cue text, subtitle_payload rejected SSA 'Marked=N' block payloads, parse_srt dropped cues with inline WebVTT 'id - time --> time' headers, and parse_ass ignored custom [Events] Format: column orders and case-insensitive Dialogue: prefixes.
entries.result: Convert '\h' to '\u{a0}', strip isolated '<...>' and '{...}' tags in plain_subtitle, accept SSA 'Marked=N' payloads in subtitle_payload, support inline WebVTT cue IDs in parse_srt, and honor custom [Events] Format: column order and case-insensitive Dialogue: lines in parse_ass.

entries.title: Support external .vtt WebVTT and .ass/.ssa ASS/SSA subtitle files in owned_subtitle_burn::supports, plan_burn_subtitles, and burn_subtitles
entries.before: owned_subtitle_burn::supports and prepare only accepted '.srt' files containing '-->', rejecting valid external '.vtt', '.ass', and '.ssa' subtitle files even though parse_subtitle_text already parsed ASS/SSA and WebVTT.
entries.result: Accept '.srt', '.vtt', '.ass', and '.ssa' subtitle files and validate WebVTT/ASS/SSA headers alongside '-->' in owned_subtitle_burn::supports, plan_burn_subtitles, and burn_subtitles.

entries.title: Preserve container Colour (colr) matrix and full_range fallback and per-frame presented_signal in WebmVideoReader and Mp4VideoReader when AVC or HEVC VUI omits colour description or reports code 2
entries.before: WebmVideoReader and Mp4VideoReader passed bitstream VUI directly to AvcColour::from_vui / from_hevc_vui without container Colour fallback when VUI matrix was absent or 2 (Unspecified) or full_range was false, and WebmVideoReader::decode_next left Frame.signal = None for single-layer AVC, HEVC, and AV1.
entries.result: Fallback to container Colour matrix and full_range in AvcColour::from_vui_with_fallback, from_hevc_vui_with_fallback, avc_picture_with_vui_and_fallback, hevc_picture_with_vui_and_fallback, and Mp4VideoReader, and record per-frame Frame.signal in WebmVideoReader::decode_next.

entries.title: Fall back to container Colour (colr) matrix and full_range for Matroska and MP4 VP9 CS_UNKNOWN and AV1 unspecified matrix
entries.before: WebmVideoReader, Mp4VideoReader, and owned_webm_codec treated VP9 color_space == 0 (CS_UNKNOWN) as an explicit BT.601 (matrix = 6) statement and ignored container Colour.full_range, overwriting container BT.709/BT.2020 matrix and full-range metadata.
entries.result: Map VP9 CS_UNKNOWN (color_space == 0) to Unspecified (matrix = 2) in owned_webm_codec and fall back to container Colour matrix and full_range for VP9 and AV1 across WebmVideoReader, Mp4VideoReader, and owned_video_decode.

entries.title: Support standalone .ssa (SubStation Alpha v4.00) script conversion and planning to Matroska S_TEXT/ASS
entries.before: owned_subtitle and native_subtitle rejected standalone '.ssa' files, required 'Layer' in [Events] Format:, rejected 'Marked=N' dialogue layer tokens, and rejected '[V4 Styles]' / 'ScriptType: v4.00' headers when muxing S_TEXT/ASS.
entries.result: Admit '.ssa' files in try_plan_with_controls and try_convert_with_controls, normalize 'Format: Marked, ...' and 'Marked=N' dialogue tokens to canonical Matroska S_TEXT/ASS events, and accept '[V4 Styles]' / 'ScriptType: v4.00' headers in owned_matroska_tracks_impl.

entries.title: Support standalone .vtt WebVTT and Matroska S_TEXT/WEBVTT subtitle conversion and planning to Matroska S_TEXT/ASS
entries.before: owned_subtitle and native_subtitle rejected '.vtt' files, Matroska 'S_TEXT/WEBVTT' tracks, and 2-part 'MM:SS.mmm' WebVTT timestamps.
entries.result: Support 2-part 'MM:SS.mmm' timestamps, standalone '.vtt' files (with WEBVTT headers, NOTE/STYLE/REGION blocks, and cue identifiers), and Matroska 'S_TEXT/WEBVTT' tracks in try_plan_with_controls and try_convert_with_controls.

entries.title: Match Dialogue:, Comment:, Format:, and Style: prefixes case-insensitively in subtitles::ass_block
entries.before: subtitles::ass_block matched only exact-case 'Dialogue:', 'Comment:', 'Format:', and 'Style:' prefixes, causing lowercase 'comment:' or 'style:' lines in Matroska ASS/SSA blocks to render as visible subtitle text and 9-field 'dialogue:' lines to be dropped.
entries.result: Match 'Dialogue', 'Comment', 'Format', and 'Style' prefixes case-insensitively with whitespace trimming in subtitles::ass_block.

entries.title: Support AAC Main/LC/SSR/LTP profiles, actual frame_samples, and in-band PCE extradata_bytes in ADTS probe
entries.before: try_adts_as rejected valid AAC Main, SSR, and LTP ADTS files by requiring object_type == 2, and probe_adts_with_options hardcoded profile = 'LC', frame_samples = 1024, and extradata_bytes = 2 even when channel_configuration == 0 produced a longer AudioSpecificConfig from an in-band PCE.
entries.result: Admit object_type 1..=4 in try_adts_as and derive StreamInfo.profile ('Main', 'LC', 'SSR', 'LTP'), frame_samples, and extradata_bytes = reader.audio_specific_config().len() from AacConfig::parse in probe_adts_with_options.

entries.title: Default omitted Y4M F frame-rate token to 25:1 in Y4mReader::new and NativeReader
entries.before: Y4mReader::new rejected valid Y4M files that omitted an explicit F frame-rate token ('playback requires a Y4M frame rate') even though Header::frame_rate, probe_y4m, and decode_video default omitted Y4M rates to 25:1 per the Y4M specification.
entries.result: Default an omitted F rate token in Y4mReader::new to (25, 1) (25 fps, 40 ms period).

entries.title: Support 440, 411, and 410 planar chroma subsampling in native Y4M export, inspection, and VideoGeometry
entries.before: inspect_first_y4m_frame_with_filters_and_options, export_y4m_sources_with_options, and VideoGeometry::apply_with_sampling only recognized 444, 422, and 420 chroma subsampling, rejecting 8-bit and high-bit-depth 440 ([1, 2]), 411 ([4, 1]), and 410 ([4, 4]) planar frames.
entries.result: Recognize 440 ([1, 2]), 411 ([4, 1]), and 410 ([4, 4]) subsampling across Planar8, Planar, and transformed GeometryFrame pictures in native_export and native_geometry.

entries.title: Support high-bit-depth C411p9..16 and C410p9..16 Y4M headers in Header::parse and try_y4m_with_options
entries.before: Header::parse and try_y4m_with_options accepted 8-bit C411 and C410 Y4M headers but rejected 9/10/12/14/16-bit C411p9..16 and C410p9..16 headers with 'unsupported Y4M chroma layout'.
entries.result: Accept '411' -> PixelFormat::Yuv411 and '410' -> PixelFormat::Yuv410 for 9/10/12/14/16-bit Y4M headers in Header::parse and try_y4m_with_options.

entries.title: Infer open-ended Matroska ChapterAtom end timestamps from next chapter start or container duration in owned_webm_probe
entries.before: owned_webm_probe::try_probe_webm_with_limits defaulted an omitted ChapterTimeEnd (chapter.end_ns == None) to start, collapsing open-ended Matroska chapters to zero-length points and disagreeing with src/media_probe.rs and owned_mp4_probe_impl.rs.
entries.result: Infer an omitted Matroska chapter end_ns from the next chapter's start_ns or the container duration_ns (clamped to >= start) in owned_webm_probe.

entries.title: Reject AIFF block-aligned SSND chunks whose declared_frames trims the sample run to empty
entries.before: Aiff::parse checked samples.is_empty() before slicing block-aligned SSND payloads to declared_frames * block_align, so an AIFF file with block_size != 0, declared_frames == 0, and non-empty SSND padding succeeded with 0 frames and 0 packets instead of returning 'an AIFF file with no samples in it'.
entries.result: Recheck samples.is_empty() after block_size != 0 trimming in Aiff::parse so empty valid sample runs are rejected.

entries.title: Support sub-sample seek_time, present_decoded presentation_floor trimming, and G.711 clock range check in AviAudioReader
entries.before: AviAudioReader lacked presentation_floor, present_decoded, and a custom seek_time override, so unquantized seek_time(Duration) floored instead of ceiling to the first sample at or after the target and ADPCM block seeks did not trim decoded samples preceding presentation_floor; laid_out_g711 also omitted the cursor > i64::MAX as u64 check.
entries.result: Track presentation_floor in AviAudioReader, implement present_decoded and div_ceil seek_time(Duration), and enforce cursor <= i64::MAX as u64 in laid_out_g711.

entries.title: Support 411 and 410 subsampling and omitted Y4M F frame-rate token in native_lossless and native_lossless_y4m
entries.before: native_lossless_y4m::eligible required an explicit F token even though Y4M defaults omitted rates to 25:1, and native_lossless::write_mp4_selected rejected [4, 1] (yuv411p) and [4, 4] (yuv410p) subsampling when formatting LosslessStats.pixel_format.
entries.result: Admit Y4M headers without an explicit F token in native_lossless_y4m::eligible and format Some([4, 1]) => 'yuv411p' and Some([4, 4]) => 'yuv410p' in native_lossless::write_mp4_selected.

entries.title: Map Matroska S_VOBSUB and S_HDMV/PGS bitmap subtitle codec IDs in media_probe and owned_webm_probe
entries.before: src/media_probe.rs and crates/fvid-media/src/owned_webm_probe.rs left Matroska bitmap subtitle codec IDs S_VOBSUB and S_HDMV/PGS unmapped instead of normalizing them to 'dvd_subtitle' and 'hdmv_pgs_subtitle'.
entries.result: Normalize 'S_VOBSUB' to 'dvd_subtitle' and 'S_HDMV/PGS' to 'hdmv_pgs_subtitle' in both Matroska probe implementations.

entries.title: Report 'data' media_type for non-AVS Matroska tracks in owned_webm_probe
entries.before: owned_webm_probe mapped non-video/audio/subtitle Matroska track kinds to 'unknown', disagreeing with src/media_probe.rs which reports 'data'.
entries.result: Map non-AVS Matroska track kinds to 'data' in owned_webm_probe to match src/media_probe.rs.

entries.title: Normalize Matroska A_WAVPACK4 codec ID to 'wavpack' in media_probe and owned_webm_probe
entries.before: src/media_probe.rs and crates/fvid-media/src/owned_webm_probe.rs left Matroska WavPack tracks with raw codec ID 'A_WAVPACK4' instead of normalizing to 'wavpack'.
entries.result: Map 'A_WAVPACK4' to 'wavpack' in both Matroska probe implementations.

entries.title: Register canonical audio and bitmap subtitle codecs in owned_codec_metadata::descriptor
entries.before: fvid_media::owned_codec_metadata::descriptor returned None for canonical codecs emitted by FVid probes ('wavpack', 'adpcm_ima_qt', 'adpcm_ima_wav', 'adpcm_ms', 'mace3', 'mace6', 'dvd_subtitle', and 'hdmv_pgs_subtitle').
entries.result: Add CodecDescriptor entries for 'wavpack', 'adpcm_ima_qt', 'adpcm_ima_wav', 'adpcm_ms', 'mace3', 'mace6', 'dvd_subtitle', and 'hdmv_pgs_subtitle' in owned_codec_metadata::descriptor.

entries.title: Map RIFF INFO ILNG tag to and from semantic 'language' metadata key in WAVE probe and metadata editor
entries.before: info_for_file_tags wrote track language as RIFF INFO 'ILNG', but owned_wave_metadata::tag_for_key rejected 'language' and owned_probe::probe_wave_with_options exposed 'ILNG' verbatim instead of 'language'.
entries.result: Map 'language' -> *b"ILNG" in tag_for_key and b"ILNG" -> "language" in probe_wave_with_options.

entries.title: Implement sub-sample div_ceil seek_time(Duration) in AacAudioReader
entries.before: AacAudioReader relied on the default AudioStream::seek_time implementation which floored (target.as_nanos() * timescale) / 1_000_000_000, landing at sample 0 (0 ns) for seek_time(Duration::from_nanos(1)) instead of ceiling to sample 1.
entries.result: Override seek_time(Duration) in AacAudioReader using div_ceil(1_000_000_000) clamped to end in output sample units.

entries.title: Implement sub-sample div_ceil seek_time(Duration) and sample_duration in Mp3AudioReader
entries.before: Mp3AudioReader relied on the default AudioStream::seek_time floor division, landing at sample 0 (0 ns) for seek_time(Duration::from_nanos(1)) instead of ceiling to sample 1, and computed duration() via manual 64-bit remainder multiplication instead of sample_duration.
entries.result: Override seek_time(Duration) in Mp3AudioReader with div_ceil(1_000_000_000) clamped to presentation_samples() / samples() and compute duration() via crate::audio::sample_duration.

entries.title: Implement sub-sample div_ceil seek_time(Duration) and sample_duration in Ac3AudioReader
entries.before: Ac3AudioReader relied on the default AudioStream::seek_time floor division, landing at sample 0 (0 ns) for seek_time(Duration::from_nanos(1)) instead of ceiling to sample 1, and computed duration() via manual 64-bit remainder multiplication instead of sample_duration.
entries.result: Override seek_time(Duration) in Ac3AudioReader with div_ceil(1_000_000_000) clamped to audible_samples() and compute duration() via crate::audio::sample_duration.

entries.title: Implement sub-sample div_ceil seek_time(Duration) in WavpackAudioReader
entries.before: WavpackAudioReader relied on the default AudioStream::seek_time floor division, landing at sample 0 (0 ns) for seek_time(Duration::from_nanos(1)) instead of ceiling to sample 1.
entries.result: Override seek_time(Duration) in WavpackAudioReader with div_ceil(1_000_000_000) in sample_rate units.

entries.title: Implement sub-sample div_ceil seek_time(Duration) in OggAudioReader, OggOpusAudioReader, and playback_ogg_catalog
entries.before: OggAudioReader, OggOpusAudioReader, and playback_ogg_catalog::Reader / Joint lacked seek_time(Duration) overrides, flooring sub-sample targets such as Duration::from_nanos(1) to sample 0 instead of ceiling to sample 1.
entries.result: Override seek_time(Duration) with div_ceil(1_000_000_000) in OggAudioReader, OggOpusAudioReader, and Joint, and delegate seek_time in playback_ogg_catalog::Reader.

entries.title: Support ID3v2.4 10-byte 3DI footer in id3v2_bytes and parse_id3v2_into for bare MPEG audio
entries.before: owned_mpeg_audio::id3v2_bytes and parse_id3v2_into ignored the ID3v2.4 footer flag (flags & 0x10), under-counting tag_bytes by 10 bytes when a 3DI footer followed the tag body.
entries.result: Account for and validate the 10-byte 3DI footer when version == 4 and flags & 0x10 != 0 in id3v2_bytes and parse_id3v2_into.

entries.title: Normalize numeric ID3v2 TCON genre codes (e.g. '(17)' or '17') via id3v1_genre_name
entries.before: parse_id3v2_into stored numeric ID3v2 TCON genre strings such as '(17)' or '17' verbatim instead of resolving them through id3v1_genre_name ('Rock').
entries.result: Resolve parenthesized or bare numeric ID3v1 genre indices in ID3v2 TCON frames via id3v1_genre_name.

entries.title: Normalize MP4 'alaw' and 'ulaw' audio sample entry FourCCs to 'pcm_alaw' and 'pcm_mulaw' in owned_mp4_probe_impl
entries.before: owned_mp4_probe_impl::audio_codec lacked 'alaw' and 'ulaw' match arms, returning raw 'alaw' and 'ulaw' codec strings instead of 'pcm_alaw' and 'pcm_mulaw' even though Mp4AudioReader and owned_mp4_audio_export support G.711 A-law and mu-law tracks.
entries.result: Map b"alaw" to "pcm_alaw" and b"ulaw" to "pcm_mulaw" in owned_mp4_probe_impl::audio_codec.

entries.title: Expand id3v1_genre_name to full standard 80-entry ID3v1 genre table (0..=79)
entries.before: id3v1_genre_name only included 22 partial entries, dropping standard ID3v1 genre bytes and numeric ID3v2 TCON references such as 19 ('Industrial'), 20 ('Alternative'), 43 ('Punk'), and 79 ('Hard Rock').
entries.result: Populate all 80 standard ID3v1 genre codes (0..=79) in id3v1_genre_name.

entries.title: Normalize YEAR, ORGANIZATION, and ENCODED-BY / ENCODED_BY metadata aliases across Vorbis comments, ID3v2 TXXX, and FileTags
entries.before: Vorbis comment probing and WAVE INFO export, ID3v2 TXXX frames, and FileTags::field did not map common aliases YEAR -> 'date', ORGANIZATION -> 'publisher', or ENCODED-BY / ENCODED_BY -> 'encoder'.
entries.result: Normalize YEAR to 'date', ORGANIZATION to 'publisher', and ENCODED-BY / ENCODED_BY to 'encoder' in owned_flac_layout, owned_ogg_opus_export, owned_mpeg_audio, and owned_file_tags.

entries.title: Implement sub-millisecond div_ceil seek_time(Duration) in SmfAudioReader
entries.before: SmfAudioReader relied on the default AudioStream::seek_time floor division at timescale 1_000, flooring sub-millisecond targets such as 99_000_001 ns to 99 ms (window 0) instead of ceiling to 100 ms (window 1).
entries.result: Override seek_time(Duration) in SmfAudioReader with div_ceil(1_000_000_000) in millisecond units.

entries.title: Implement sub-millisecond div_ceil seek_time(Duration) in XmAudioReader
entries.before: XmAudioReader relied on the default AudioStream::seek_time floor division at timescale 1_000, flooring sub-millisecond targets such as 119_000_001 ns to 119 ms (row 0) instead of ceiling to 120 ms (row 1).
entries.result: Override seek_time(Duration) in XmAudioReader with div_ceil(1_000_000_000) in millisecond units.

entries.title: Case-insensitive [Events] and WEBVTT header sniffing in subtitles::parse
entries.before: subtitles::parse checked text.contains("[Events]") and text.trim_start().starts_with("WEBVTT") case-sensitively, routing ASS/SSA scripts with [events] or [EVENTS] headers and WebVTT files with lowercase webvtt headers to parse_srt (returning zero cues).
entries.result: Sniff WEBVTT and [Events] headers case-insensitively in subtitles::parse.

entries.title: Decode named and numeric HTML character entities in subtitles::plain after stripping tags
entries.before: subtitles::plain stripped <...> tags and {...} override blocks without decoding HTML character entities (&, <, >, ", ',  , ', !), leaving raw entity markup visible in rendered SRT, WebVTT, ASS/SSA, MP4 tx3g, and Matroska text subtitles.
entries.result: Decode standard named (&, <, >, ", ',  ) and decimal/hexadecimal numeric HTML character entities in subtitles::plain after tag stripping.

entries.title: Case-insensitive WebVTT header and NOTE/STYLE/REGION block skipping in parse_webvtt and owned_subtitle::try_convert_srt_inner
entries.before: parse_webvtt and owned_subtitle::try_convert_srt_inner matched WEBVTT, NOTE, STYLE, and REGION block headers with case-sensitive comparisons, failing or misparsing WebVTT files that used lowercase or mixed-case block keywords.
entries.result: Match WEBVTT, NOTE, STYLE, and REGION block headers case-insensitively in both subtitles::parse_webvtt and owned_subtitle::try_convert_srt_inner.

entries.title: Normalize Matroska S_DVBSUB codec ID to 'dvb_subtitle' and register in owned_codec_metadata
entries.before: media_probe and owned_webm_probe returned the raw Matroska CodecID 'S_DVBSUB' instead of 'dvb_subtitle', and owned_codec_metadata::descriptor("dvb_subtitle") returned None.
entries.result: Map 'S_DVBSUB' to 'dvb_subtitle' in media_probe and owned_webm_probe and register 'dvb_subtitle' in owned_codec_metadata::descriptor.

entries.title: Validate Y4M pixel_aspect() and full_range() tokens during owned_y4m_probe inspection
entries.before: owned_y4m_probe::probe_y4m_with_options validated Y4M dimensions, chroma format, and frame_rate() but omitted header.pixel_aspect() and header.full_range(), allowing malformed A1:0 or XCOLORRANGE=BOGUS Y4M headers to pass probe inspection.
entries.result: Validate header.pixel_aspect() and header.full_range() in owned_y4m_probe::try_y4m_with_options and probe_y4m_with_options.

entries.title: Compare effective_channel_mask() when validating WAVE concat input compatibility
entries.before: owned_wave_remux::copy_waves compared raw channel_mask instead of effective_channel_mask(), allowing classic 16-byte fmt stereo/mono files (implicit speaker mask 0x3/0x4, channel_mask == 0) to concatenate with WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE DirectOut files (explicit dwChannelMask == 0, unassigned speakers) and silently relabel speaker assignments.
entries.result: Compare effective_channel_mask() in owned_wave_remux::copy_waves so classic stereo/mono and WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE DirectOut layouts are rejected as incompatible during WAVE concat.

entries.title: Preserve explicit DirectOut zero speaker mask in owned_g711_wave_export via effective_channel_mask()
entries.before: owned_g711_wave_export::open replaced any zero channel_mask on 1- or 2-channel G.711 WAVE inputs with standard masks 4 (FC) or 3 (FL|FR), ignoring channel_mask_explicit on WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE DirectOut G.711 files.
entries.result: Use shape.effective_channel_mask() in owned_g711_wave_export::open so WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE G.711 inputs with explicit dwChannelMask == 0 retain unassigned channel mask 0.

entries.title: Require wValidBitsPerSample == 8 for WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE G.711 in owned_wave_inspect
entries.before: owned_wave_inspect::inspect_impl rewrote the WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE G.711 subformat GUID to linear PCM (1) before calling format(), allowing wValidBitsPerSample values 1..=7 on 8-bit G.711 WAVE files.
entries.result: Require wValidBitsPerSample == 8 (bytes[18..20] == 8) when inspecting 40-byte WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE G.711 fmt chunks in owned_wave_inspect::inspect_impl.

entries.title: Admit WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE G.711 (Coding::ALaw and Coding::MuLaw) in AviAudioReader::open_at
entries.before: AviAudioReader::open_at only accepted Coding::Pcm(_) when parsing 0xfffe WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE strf headers via playback_wav::parse_fmt, skipping valid WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE A-law and mu-law AVI audio tracks.
entries.result: Match Coding::ALaw and Coding::MuLaw alongside Coding::Pcm(_) for 0xfffe WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE audio streams in AviAudioReader::open_at.

entries.title: Skip empty Vorbis comment values when mapping standard FLAC tags to RIFF INFO in wave_info_from_extra
entries.before: owned_flac_layout::wave_info_from_extra matched the first Vorbis comment with key source even when its value was empty, emitting empty RIFF INFO tags and blocking fallback aliases such as YEAR -> date when preceded by an empty DATE= field.
entries.result: Require !v.is_empty() && !v.contains('\0') when searching Vorbis comments in owned_flac_layout::wave_info_from_extra.

entries.title: Skip empty Ogg comment values in info_for_tags, owned_ogg_opus::Program, and owned_ogg_audio_catalog
entries.before: owned_ogg_opus_export::info_for_tags, owned_ogg_opus::Program::from_ogg, and owned_ogg_audio_catalog::from_ogg used OpusTags::get(key), which returned the first matching comment even when empty, writing empty RIFF INFO tags, hiding subsequent non-empty TITLE/LANGUAGE values, and blocking fallback aliases such as YEAR -> date.
entries.result: Use OpusTags::get_all(key).find(|v| !v.is_empty() && !v.contains('\0')) so empty Ogg comments are skipped in favor of the first non-empty value.

entries.title: Populate AudioTrack name and language from Vorbis comment header in owned_ogg_vorbis::Program
entries.before: owned_ogg_vorbis::Program::from_ogg hardcoded AudioTrack { name: String::new(), language: String::new() } instead of parsing the Vorbis comment packet, losing track TITLE and LANGUAGE when opening Ogg Vorbis streams directly.
entries.result: Parse the Vorbis comment packet in owned_ogg_vorbis::Program::from_ogg and populate AudioTrack.name and AudioTrack.language from the first non-empty TITLE and LANGUAGE comments.

entries.title: Cap RIFF INFO entries at 64 while preserving canonical tags in Mp3::wave_info and info_for_file_tags
entries.before: Mp3::wave_info and owned_wave_metadata::info_for_file_tags passed all 4-character custom tags plus canonical tags to edit_info_chunks without capping at 64 entries, causing WAVE export to fail with 'at most 64 container metadata mutations' when a file carried more than 64 tags.
entries.result: Drain excess custom entries from the front of entries when entries.len() > 64 in Mp3::wave_info and owned_wave_metadata::info_for_file_tags so canonical tags at the tail are preserved within the 64-entry RIFF INFO limit.

entries.title: Skip empty RIFF INFO entries in probe_wave_with_options
entries.before: probe_wave_with_options inserted RIFF INFO entries into MediaInfo.metadata even when the NUL-trimmed text was empty, unlike MP4, Matroska, FLAC, Ogg, and MPEG probes.
entries.result: Skip empty NUL-trimmed RIFF INFO strings (!text.is_empty()) in probe_wave_with_options.

entries.title: Skip empty ID3v2 text, TXXX, and COMM frames in owned_mpeg_audio::parse_id3v2_into
entries.before: parse_id3v2_into inserted empty decoded strings via container.entry(...).or_insert(val), causing an empty ID3v2 frame (such as an empty TIT2 or TYER) to block a subsequent non-empty frame or ID3v1 fallback for the same canonical key.
entries.result: Filter out empty decoded ID3v2 strings (.filter(|v| !v.is_empty())) across TXXX, COMM, and standard text frames in parse_id3v2_into.

entries.title: Require 8-bit storage and precision for WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE G.711 in Wav::parse
entries.before: parse_fmt in src/playback/audio/wav.rs overwrote bits with valid_bits for compressed WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE subformats without checking that G.711 A-law/mu-law storage width wBitsPerSample was 8, accepting malformed extensible G.711 headers with 16-bit container storage.
entries.result: Require bits == 8 && valid_bits == 8 for ALAW | MULAW in the WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE match arm of parse_fmt.

entries.title: Populate AudioTrack name and language from Vorbis comments in FlacAudioReader::audio_tracks
entries.before: FlacAudioReader::audio_tracks hardcoded empty name and language strings even though self.flac.metadata_blocks() retained the FLAC VORBIS_COMMENT metadata block.
entries.result: Extract the first non-empty TITLE and LANGUAGE Vorbis comments from self.flac.metadata_blocks() in FlacAudioReader::audio_tracks.

entries.title: Populate AudioTrack name and language from ID3 metadata in Mp3AudioReader::audio_tracks
entries.before: Mp3AudioReader::audio_tracks hardcoded empty name and language strings despite self.mp3.probe_metadata() parsing ID3v2/ID3v1 title and language.
entries.result: Populate AudioTrack.name and AudioTrack.language from self.mp3.probe_metadata().1 in Mp3AudioReader::audio_tracks.

entries.title: Trim trailing NUL bytes from SMF FF 03 track/sequence names before emptiness check
entries.before: parse_meta in src/container/smf.rs kept trailing NUL bytes in FF 03 track/sequence names, so a NUL-only conductor track name (e.g. "\0\0") was treated as non-empty and shadowed real track names in subsequent tracks, and NUL-terminated names retained trailing '\0'.
entries.result: Trim trailing '\0' bytes from FF 03 payloads before checking !text.is_empty() in parse_meta.

entries.title: Write final timeline row BPM and speed into XM release tail packet header
entries.before: Module::packet wrote the module header's initial self.bpm and self.speed into the release tail packet even when Fxx tempo/speed effects changed the active BPM and speed on the timeline, mismatched against the tail packet's duration_microseconds (which used the last timeline row).
entries.result: Use self.timeline.last().map_or((self.bpm, self.speed), |row| (row.bpm, row.speed)) when serializing the XM tail packet header in Module::packet.

entries.title: Require 4-bit storage and precision for WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE G.722 and Creative ADPCM in Wav::parse
entries.before: parse_fmt in src/playback/audio/wav.rs overwrote bits (container wBitsPerSample) with valid_bits (wValidBitsPerSample / wSamplesPerBlock) in the WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE wildcard arm before checking bits == 4, accepting malformed extensible G.722 and Creative ADPCM headers with 16-bit container storage and breaking IMA ADPCM wBitsPerSample validation.
entries.result: Keep container wBitsPerSample for IMA ADPCM (0x0011) and require bits == 4 && valid_bits == 4 for G722_ADPCM | ADPCM_CT in the WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE match of parse_fmt.

entries.title: Bound bare MP3 frame estimation by controls.max_packets in audio_plan_with_controls
entries.before: audio_plan_with_controls ignored controls.max_packets for bare MP3 inputs and always estimated parsed.presentation_samples(), overestimating input and output PCM working bytes and falsely failing max_controlled_bytes during plan_mix_audio_with_controls and plan_merge_audio_with_controls.
entries.result: Bound bare MP3 sample estimation in audio_plan_with_controls by controls.max_packets (counting any leading Info packet) to match decode_raw_mpeg_pcm execution.

entries.title: Validate ReadOrder and Layer integer fields in Matroska S_TEXT/ASS and S_TEXT/SSA conversion
entries.before: try_convert_matroska_inner only rewrote SSA Marked=<digits> layers and passed all other 9-field S_TEXT/ASS and S_TEXT/SSA packet payloads through without validating that ReadOrder and Layer were valid integers, emitting malformed ASS events when ReadOrder or Layer was non-numeric (e.g. 'Marked=abc').
entries.result: Validate fields[0] as u64 and fields[1] (or the value after 'Marked=') as i32 in try_convert_matroska_inner before accepting Matroska ASS/SSA subtitle packets.

entries.title: Enforce max_packets and max_controlled_bytes on WebVTT cues sharing the WEBVTT header block
entries.before: When a WebVTT file placed its first cue in the same paragraph block as the opening WEBVTT header line, try_convert_srt_inner pushed the cue and continued without checking max_packets or max_controlled_bytes.
entries.result: Check max_packets before parsing and max_controlled_bytes after accumulating event_bytes in the inline WEBVTT header cue branch of try_convert_srt_inner.

entries.title: Require colon-separated MM:SS or HH:MM:SS with minutes < 60 and seconds < 60 in subtitles::clock
entries.before: subtitles::clock defaulted missing minutes to 0 and did not check seconds < 60 or minutes < 60, accepting bare numbers without colons (e.g. '12,000') and invalid 60+ minute/second fields as valid subtitle timestamps.
entries.result: Require at least minutes and seconds separated by ':' and enforce seconds < 60 && minutes < 60 in subtitles::clock.

entries.title: Count leading Info packet and active presentation window frames in standalone_packet_work for bare MP3
entries.before: standalone_packet_work returned parsed.frames.len() for bare MP3 inputs, omitting any leading Info/Xing packet (which decode_raw_mpeg_pcm counts toward ProgressEvent.packets and max_packets) and including trailing frames past presentation_window().end.
entries.result: Count frames with pts < presentation_window().end plus usize::from(parsed.info_packet().is_some()) in standalone_packet_work.

entries.title: Bound bare FLAC interval prefix check by options.max_packets in open_with_interval
entries.before: owned_raw_flac::open_with_interval passed the unclipped sample count to check_nonempty_interval_prefix even when options.max_packets restricted decoding to an earlier packet prefix, allowing plan_decode_audio and supports to accept intervals that fall entirely after the max_packets prefix.
entries.result: Bound prefix_samples by options.max_packets before calling check_nonempty_interval_prefix in owned_raw_flac::open_with_interval.

entries.title: Bound bare MP3 interval prefix and spool budget by options.max_packets in open_with_interval
entries.before: owned_raw_mp3::open_with_interval did not bound prefix_samples by options.max_packets (nor reject max_packets == Some(1) when consumed by a leading Info packet), allowing plan_decode_audio and supports to accept intervals or Info-only packet limits that decode zero audio samples.
entries.result: Reject packet limits that decode zero audio frames and bound prefix_samples by options.max_packets in owned_raw_mp3::open_with_interval.

entries.title: Validate non-empty transform.interval during Matroska PCM geometry_for_decode
entries.before: Unlike all other Matroska audio export modules, owned_matroska_pcm_export::geometry_for_decode omitted the decode_matroska_pcm_f64 + check_nonempty_interval_prefix check when transform.interval was set, causing plan_decode_audio to accept out-of-range or empty intervals on Matroska PCM tracks.
entries.result: Probe decode_matroska_pcm_f64 into sink and call check_nonempty_interval_prefix when transform.interval is present in owned_matroska_pcm_export::geometry_for_decode.
