entries.title: Use track_languages (LanguageIETF) in matroska_source_info_with_interval for WAVE export
entries.before: matroska_source_info_with_interval passed &track.language directly to info_for_file_tags instead of consulting reader.track_languages, ignoring Matroska LanguageIETF (0x22B59D) when building RIFF INFO (ILNG) metadata for WAVE export.
entries.result: Resolve reader.track_languages.get(&track.number).unwrap_or(&track.language) in matroska_source_info_with_interval before calling info_for_file_tags.

entries.title: Bound Ogg Opus interval prefix check by options.max_packets in open_with_transform
entries.before: owned_ogg_opus_export::open_with_transform passed the full stream sample count to check_nonempty_interval_prefix without bounding by options.max_packets, allowing plan_decode_audio and supports to accept intervals that fall entirely after the max_packets prefix.
entries.result: Add Program::prefix_end_samples(until, max_packets) in owned_ogg_opus and pass it to check_nonempty_interval_prefix in owned_ogg_opus_export::open_with_transform.

entries.title: Bound Ogg Vorbis interval prefix check by options.max_packets in open_with_transform
entries.before: owned_ogg_vorbis_export::open_with_transform passed the full stream sample count to check_nonempty_interval_prefix without bounding by options.max_packets, allowing plan_decode_audio and supports to accept intervals that fall after the max_packets prefix.
entries.result: Add Program::prefix_end_samples(until, max_packets) in owned_ogg_vorbis and pass it to check_nonempty_interval_prefix in owned_ogg_vorbis_export::open_with_transform.

entries.title: Bound linked Ogg Joint interval prefix check by options.max_packets in open_with_transform
entries.before: owned_ogg_joint_export::open_with_transform passed the full linked program sample count to check_nonempty_interval_prefix without bounding by options.max_packets across links, allowing plan_decode_audio and supports to accept intervals in later links beyond the max_packets limit.
entries.result: Add Program::prefix_end_samples(until, max_packets) in owned_ogg_audio_program and pass it to check_nonempty_interval_prefix in owned_ogg_joint_export::open_with_transform.

entries.title: Bound G.711 WAVE spool export budget by options.max_packets in apply
entries.before: owned_g711_wave_export::apply passed end.max(1024) to check_spool_wave_export_budget without bounding by options.max_packets * packet_window, overestimating Stage-2 PCM export memory when max_packets limited decoding.
entries.result: Bound frames_read by options.max_packets.map_or(end, |pkts| end.min(pkts.saturating_mul(window as u64))) before calling check_spool_wave_export_budget in owned_g711_wave_export::apply.

entries.title: Use actual G.711 frame count in plan_decode_audio Stage-2 spool budget check
entries.before: source_descriptor_for_decode discarded the frames_read count returned by owned_g711_wave_export::descriptor_with_transform and plan_decode_audio passed a hardcoded 1024 frames to check_spool_wave_export_budget for G.711 WAVE inputs, underestimating Stage-2 export memory relative to apply.
entries.result: Preserve g711_frames in AudioDescriptor and pass g711_frames.max(1024) to check_spool_wave_export_budget in plan_decode_audio.

entries.title: Preserve canonical RIFF INFO tags past 64 custom Vorbis comments in bare FLAC WAVE export
entries.before: wave_info_from_extra appended canonical RIFF INFO tags (TITLE, ARTIST, ALBUM, COMMENT, DATE, GENRE, TRACKNUMBER, LANGUAGE, ENCODER) after custom 4-character Vorbis comments and then called entries.truncate(64), dropping canonical metadata whenever 64 or more custom 4-char tags preceded them.
entries.result: Drain excess leading custom entries via entries.drain(0..excess) when entries.len() > 64 so canonical RIFF INFO tags appended at the end are preserved.

entries.title: Preserve canonical RIFF INFO tags past 64 custom Vorbis comments in Ogg WAVE export
entries.before: info_for_tags appended canonical RIFF INFO tags after custom 4-character Vorbis comments and then called entries.truncate(64), dropping canonical metadata in Ogg Opus, Vorbis, and linked Joint WAVE exports whenever 64 or more custom 4-char tags preceded them.
entries.result: Drain excess leading custom entries via entries.drain(0..excess) when entries.len() > 64 so canonical RIFF INFO tags appended at the end are preserved.

entries.title: Enforce actual prefix sample frames and metadata size in Ogg Stage-2 WAVE spool budget
entries.before: Ogg Opus, Vorbis, and Joint WAVE export apply and plan_decode_audio passed a hardcoded 1024 sample frames (and 0 metadata bytes in plan_decode_audio) to check_spool_wave_export_budget, underestimating Stage-2 WAVE DSP memory for multi-packet Ogg streams until export_spool failed after decoding.
entries.result: Compute prefix_end_samples(until, options.max_packets) and info.len() in descriptor_for_decode and apply across Ogg Opus, Vorbis, and Joint exports and wire them into plan_decode_audio and apply Stage-2 budget admission.

entries.title: Enforce actual prefix sample frames in bare FLAC and bare MPEG Stage-2 WAVE spool budget in apply
entries.before: owned_raw_flac::apply and owned_raw_mp3::apply passed a hardcoded 1024 sample frames to their direct check_spool_wave_export_budget preflight instead of the max_packets- and interval-bounded prefix frame count.
entries.result: Compute the interval- and max_packets-bounded prefix sample frame count in owned_raw_flac::apply and owned_raw_mp3::apply and pass prefix.max(1024) to check_spool_wave_export_budget.

entries.title: Enforce actual decoded prefix sample frames in ADTS AAC Stage-2 WAVE spool budget
entries.before: plan_decode_audio and owned_adts_export::apply passed a hardcoded 1024 sample frames to check_spool_wave_export_budget for ADTS AAC inputs, allowing plan_decode_audio to admit multi-frame ADTS streams whose Stage-2 WAVE DSP buffers exceed max_controlled_bytes.
entries.result: Return the decoded prefix sample_frames from adts_prefix_info_for_transform when max_controlled_bytes and Stage-2 WAVE DSP or metadata edits are active, and pass stage2_frames.max(1024) to check_spool_wave_export_budget in plan_decode_audio.

entries.title: Bound Ogg Opus, Vorbis, and Joint frame estimates by controls.max_packets in audio_plan_with_controls
entries.before: audio_plan_with_controls estimated Ogg Opus, Vorbis, and Joint input sample frames using p.end_samples() (the full stream duration) instead of p.prefix_end_samples(None, controls.max_packets), causing plan_mix_audio_with_controls and plan_merge_audio_with_controls to overestimate working buffer memory and reject max_packets-bounded Ogg mixes that succeed during execution.
entries.result: Use p.prefix_end_samples(None, controls.max_packets) for Ogg Opus, Vorbis, and Joint inputs in audio_plan_with_controls.

entries.title: Check Ogg audio packet work instead of framing header packet count in probe_ogg_with_options
entries.before: probe_ogg_with_options checked options.max_packets against preflight limits.packets (which includes OpusHead + OpusTags or Vorbis identification + comment + setup header packets), rejecting probe_with_options when max_packets equaled standalone_packet_work.
entries.result: Check options.max_packets against each stream's audio packet work (program.packet_count() for Opus, program.packet_times().len() for Vorbis, and program.packet_work() for Joint).

entries.title: Check active presentation frames plus leading Info packet against max_packets in probe_mpeg_with_options
entries.before: probe_mpeg_with_options checked source.frames.len() against options.max_packets, ignoring both the leading Xing/LAME Info packet and trailing frames trimmed by end_padding (pts >= presentation_window().end), diverging from standalone_packet_work and owned_raw_mp3.
entries.result: Compute active_frames + usize::from(source.info_packet().is_some()) for frames with pts < source.presentation_window().end and check that packet work against options.max_packets in probe_mpeg_with_options.

entries.title: Omit empty title metadata for untitled Matroska chapters in frontend media_probe
entries.before: src/media_probe.rs::matroska_with_limits unconditionally inserted ("title", chapter.title.clone()) into ChapterInfo.metadata, producing {"title": ""} for untitled Matroska chapters instead of an empty map like owned_webm_probe.
entries.result: Omit the "title" metadata entry in matroska_with_limits when chapter.title.is_empty().

entries.title: Enforce actual prefix sample frames and metadata size in check_spool_loudnorm_budget
entries.before: check_spool_loudnorm_budget used a hardcoded frames = 1usize and ignored source WAVE INFO metadata bytes, allowing container plan_loudnorm to admit multi-packet Ogg, FLAC, MP3, and G.711 streams under tight max_controlled_bytes that subsequently failed in Stage-2 WAVE loudnorm.
entries.result: Thread stage2_frames and stage2_meta_bytes from source_descriptor into check_spool_loudnorm_budget for owned_container_loudnorm::plan_loudnorm and apply.

entries.title: Include loudness histogram bin memory and negotiated ADTS geometry in check_meter_budget
entries.before: owned_container_loudness::check_meter_budget and owned_adts_loudness::check_meter_budget omitted the (integrated_blocks + short_blocks) * 512 loudness histogram bin memory charged by owned_wave_loudness::preflight, and owned_adts_loudness::check_meter_budget used un-negotiated ADTS header rate/channels instead of negotiated SBR+PS geometry.
entries.result: Pass prefix sample frames to owned_container_loudness::check_meter_budget, negotiate ADTS prefix geometry in owned_adts_loudness::check_meter_budget, and include (integrated_blocks + short_blocks) * 512 in both meter budget checks.

entries.title: Enforce negotiated ADTS geometry and actual prefix sample frames in owned_adts_loudnorm spool budget
entries.before: adts_prefix_info_for_transform returned a hardcoded 1024 frames whenever transform was None, and owned_adts_loudnorm::plan_loudnorm and apply passed un-negotiated ADTS header (rate, channels) and 1024 frames to check_spool_loudnorm_budget.
entries.result: Decode prefix sample frames in adts_prefix_info_for_transform when transform is None and max_controlled_bytes is set, and pass negotiated (rate, channels, stage2_frames) from source_descriptor into check_spool_loudnorm_budget in owned_adts_loudnorm.

entries.title: Propagate G.711 WAVE RIFF INFO metadata size into source_descriptor_for_decode Stage-2 budget
entries.before: owned_g711_wave_export::descriptor_with_transform discarded the RIFF INFO metadata Vec<u8> returned by open, leaving stage2_meta_bytes = 0 for G.711 WAVE sources in source_descriptor_for_decode and allowing plan_decode_audio with a default transform to skip check_spool_wave_export_budget completely.
entries.result: Expose owned_g711_wave_export::descriptor_for_decode returning info.len() and set stage2_meta_bytes = info_len for G.711 WAVE inputs in source_descriptor_for_decode.

entries.title: Populate Stage-2 WAVE metadata bytes for MP4 and Matroska audio inputs in source_descriptor_for_decode
entries.before: source_descriptor_for_decode left stage2_meta_bytes = 0 for MP4 and Matroska audio inputs even though apply and decode_to_wave append mp4_source_info / matroska_source_info_with_interval to the intermediate WAVE spool, causing plan_decode_audio and container loudnorm to underestimate Stage-2 memory.
entries.result: Set stage2_meta_bytes from mp4_source_info and matroska_source_info_with_interval in source_descriptor_for_decode.

entries.title: Include ADTS decoded prefix frame estimates in audio_plan_with_controls mix and merge budget
entries.before: audio_plan_with_controls set est_frames = None for ADTS inputs, skipping the total_input_pcm_bytes + out_bytes working buffer budget check in plan_mix_audio_with_controls and plan_merge_audio_with_controls for ADTS sources.
entries.result: Use Some(info.stage2_frames) as est_frames for ADTS inputs in audio_plan_with_controls.

entries.title: Enforce actual prefix sample frames in MP4 audio Stage-2 WAVE spool, loudness, and loudnorm budgets
entries.before: MP4 audio export, decode planning, loudness, and loudnorm passed the 1000-frame minimum floor to check_spool_wave_export_budget, check_meter_budget, and check_spool_loudnorm_budget regardless of actual audio track duration.
entries.result: Compute the MP4 audio track's presentation frame count bounded by max_packets, edit clock, and transform.interval in geometry_and_frames_for_decode and enforce it across Stage-2 WAVE spool, loudness, and loudnorm budgets.

entries.title: Enforce actual prefix sample frames in Matroska audio Stage-2 WAVE spool, loudness, and loudnorm budgets
entries.before: Matroska audio export modules (PCM, AAC, FLAC, Opus, ALAC, MP3), decode planning, loudness, and loudnorm passed the 1000-frame minimum floor to check_spool_wave_export_budget, check_meter_budget, and check_spool_loudnorm_budget regardless of actual track timeline duration.
entries.result: Compute the Matroska audio track's presentation frame count bounded by max_packets and transform.interval in matroska_estimated_frames and enforce it across all Matroska audio export, decode planning, loudness, and loudnorm budgets.

entries.title: Enforce MP4 and Matroska Stage-2 frame estimates and float32 precision in audio_plan_with_controls
entries.before: audio_plan_with_controls passed est_frames = None for MP4 and Matroska audio inputs (skipping total_input_pcm_bytes + out_bytes admission in plan_mix_audio_with_controls and plan_merge_audio_with_controls) and admitted float64-spooled MP4/Matroska PCM inputs that decode_owned_audio_with_controls rejects at execution time.
entries.result: Reject non-float32-spooled container inputs in audio_plan_with_controls and pass Some(info.stage2_frames) as est_frames for float32-spooled MP4 and Matroska inputs.

entries.title: Enforce Stage-2 WAVE spool budget on identity-transform metadata-free ADTS AAC inputs
entries.before: owned_adts_export::check_spool_wave_export_budget returned Ok(()) immediately when transform was identity and metadata_bytes == 0, allowing plan_decode_audio and decode_audio to bypass max_working_bytes on Stage-2 WAVE spool allocation for metadata-free ADTS inputs.
entries.result: Always enforce estimate_float_wave_export_bytes in owned_adts_export::check_spool_wave_export_budget regardless of transform identity or metadata presence.

entries.title: Enforce Stage-2 WAVE decode spool budget for G.711 WAVE inputs in audio_plan_with_controls
entries.before: audio_plan_with_controls skipped plan_decode_audio in the G.711 WAVE branch while decode_owned_audio_with_controls called decode_audio to spool G.711 WAVE to float32 WAVE, allowing plan_mix_audio_with_controls and plan_merge_audio_with_controls to admit G.711 WAVE inputs whose Stage-2 decode spool exceeded max_working_bytes.
entries.result: Call plan_decode_audio(source, &Default::default(), controls) in the G.711 WAVE branch of audio_plan_with_controls.

entries.title: Support standalone audio containers in owned_container_loudnorm::apply
entries.before: owned_container_loudnorm::apply branched only on MP4 vs Matroska when computing source geometry and Stage-2 spool budgets, causing apply_loudnorm and apply_loudnorm_dual to fail with 'Matroska audio stream is absent' on standalone audio containers (G.711 WAVE, Ogg, bare FLAC, bare MPEG) even though plan_loudnorm and supports accepted them.
entries.result: Query owned_container_loudness::geometry and owned_audio_plan::source_descriptor in owned_container_loudnorm::apply so all standalone audio containers execute single-pass and dual-pass loudnorm cleanly.

entries.title: Refuse shuffleplanes on monochrome video frames consistently in process_frame_with_overlay
entries.before: process_frame_with_overlay synthesized a 3-plane Y4M header for monochrome video frames and invoked transform_frame_requested_clock when shuffleplanes was set, failing with 'Y4M frame size mismatch' or misformatting pixel_format instead of refusing monochrome shuffleplanes cleanly.
entries.result: Return Ok(None) when monochrome && transform.shuffleplanes.is_some() in process_frame_with_overlay.

entries.title: Charge alpha, display-geometry, and mask working memory in subtitle burn planning and execution and reject existing outputs upfront
entries.before: plan_burn_subtitles omitted view.alpha and view.extra_working_bytes from frame_working_bytes, burn_subtitles passed only cues_only_bytes (without mask_bytes) to export_processed, and burn_subtitles ran prepare (including MP4 video bridging and subtitle parsing) before checking if destination already existed.
entries.result: Include view.alpha and view.extra_working_bytes in plan_burn_subtitles frame_working_bytes, pass cues_only_bytes.saturating_add(mask_bytes) to export_processed in burn_subtitles, and check destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() before prepare in burn_subtitles.

entries.title: Filter overlong or NUL-containing source Matroska tags in subtitle conversion and validate PacketWriter metadata during dry_run
entries.before: try_convert_matroska_inner copied source Matroska writing_app, container metadata, and track tags into output metadata without filtering >128-byte keys, >1024-byte values, or embedded NULs, and publish_events_with_metadata skipped PacketWriter::new_with_text_metadata validation when dry_run was true.
entries.result: Filter overlong and NUL-containing source writing_app, container tags, and track tags in try_convert_matroska_inner and validate PacketWriter::new_with_text_metadata on an in-memory Cursor during dry_run in publish_events_with_metadata.

entries.title: Enforce 256-tag Matroska stream metadata cap in extract_adts_matroska_metadata and defer 0-packet ADTS progress until packet admission
entries.before: extract_adts_matroska_metadata did not check the 256-tag Matroska stream tag limit (allowing plan_remux and plan_concat to accept >256 stream tags on ADTS inputs that fail at execution), and write_aac_packets emitted a 0-packet ProgressEvent before reading and budget-checking the first ADTS packet.
entries.result: Reject >256 stream tags in extract_adts_matroska_metadata and emit the initial 0-packet ProgressEvent in write_aac_packets only after the first packet passes max_controlled_bytes admission (or when the stream is empty).

entries.title: Charge decompressed zlib packet payload and read overhead in Matroska identity copy and defer 0-packet progress until preflight succeeds
entries.before: inspect_with_packet_and_memory_limits checked index_bytes.saturating_add(packet.size) using only the compressed on-disk packet size instead of packet_payload_size + packet_read_overhead, and copy_with_packet_and_memory_limits emitted a 0-packet ProgressEvent before inspection and source-length verification.
entries.result: Charge packet_payload_size(index) + packet_read_overhead(index) against max_controlled_bytes in inspect_with_packet_and_memory_limits and emit the initial 0-packet ProgressEvent in copy_with_packet_and_memory_limits only after inspection, length validation, and copy buffer allocation succeed.

entries.title: Validate Y4M colour range, pixel aspect, and Matroska PacketWriter metadata in plan_xfade and check existing outputs upfront in xfade_video
entries.before: plan_xfade skipped header.pixel_aspect(), header.full_range(), and PacketWriter::new_ffv1_with_track_description dry-run validation, visit_y4m_counted cloned frame buffers without owned_frame::buffer, and xfade_video opened input sources before checking if destination already existed.
entries.result: Validate pixel_aspect, full_range, and PacketWriter::new_ffv1_with_track_description on an in-memory Cursor in plan_xfade, allocate working frames via owned_frame::buffer in visit_y4m_counted, and reject existing destination paths upfront in xfade_video and export_y4m_ffv1_counted.

entries.title: Defer initial 0-packet WAVE remux and concat progress until preflight and temporary reservation succeed
entries.before: copy_waves emitted a 0-packet ProgressEvent before inspecting WAVE inputs, validating packet capacity, trim boundaries, concat format compatibility, or controlled memory budgets, and allocated the copy buffer with unguarded vec![0; capacity].
entries.result: Allocate the copy buffer via owned_frame::buffer(capacity) and emit the initial 0-packet ProgressEvent only after all WAVE inspection, trim, concat, budget, and temporary output reservation checks succeed.

entries.title: Include source MP4 metadata and per-track scoped stream tags in multitrack MP4 lossless qualification budget
entries.before: owned_mp4_multitrack_export::qualify computed meta_working_bytes using only options_matroska_metadata_working_bytes(&selected_options), omitting source MP4 tags, chapters, encoder, and track names/languages and collapsing identical stream_metadata_set keys across distinct tracks into a single map.
entries.result: Compute meta_working_bytes in qualify from source MP4 FileMetadata, encoder, per-track names/languages, and per-track scoped stream tag maps, and enforce the 256-tag per-stream Matroska metadata cap.

entries.title: Reject existing outputs upfront and defer 0-packet progress until preflight in native Y4M export and concat
entries.before: export_y4m_pipeline_with_options, concat_y4m_with_options, and export_y4m_sources_with_options did not check destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() before probing/decoding inputs, and DecodeProgress::new_with_limits emitted a 0-packet ProgressEvent before source packet/memory budget validation and concat compatibility checks.
entries.result: Check destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() upfront in export_y4m_pipeline_with_options, concat_y4m_with_options, and export_y4m_sources_with_options, and run all source budget and concat compatibility validations before creating the temporary file and emitting the initial 0-packet ProgressEvent.

entries.title: Enforce 256-tag Matroska container and stream metadata caps and audio track title/language budgets in owned_webm_multitrack_export::qualify
entries.before: check_multitrack_matroska_metadata_budget did not check whether merged source + user container tags or per-stream tags exceeded Matroska's 256-tag cap, and silently dropped stream_metadata_set title/language overrides on non-video tracks instead of charging their working set.
entries.result: Enforce tags.len() <= 256 and text_tags.len() <= 256 in check_multitrack_matroska_metadata_budget and charge non-video track name and language overrides against meta_working_bytes.

entries.title: Check existing overlay destination upfront before scanning main input and preserve MP4 encoder tag in native_lossless::write_mp4_selected
entries.before: overlay_video_transformed called overlay_eligible(main) before checking whether destination already existed and used destination.try_exists() instead of symlink_metadata(), and native_lossless::write_mp4_selected passed an empty text_tags map to PacketWriter::new_with_track_preferences, dropping the source MP4 ©too encoder tag.
entries.result: Reject destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() at the start of overlay_video_transformed before opening main, and populate text_tags with ENCODER from input.encoder() in native_lossless::write_mp4_selected.

entries.title: Charge simultaneous MP4 index and sample working set in O(1) for uniform sample tables during MP4 fast-start relocation planning and remux
entries.before: validate_mp4_packet_budget and native_plan::remux_with_options iterated 0..track.samples.len() even on compact SampleIndex::Uniform tables and checked sample.size > mem_limit without adding index_bytes, allowing plan_remux and remux to admit MP4 inputs whose index_bytes + max_sample_size exceeded max_controlled_bytes.
entries.result: Inspect SampleIndex::Uniform in O(1) vs SampleIndex::Expanded in validate_mp4_packet_budget and native_plan::remux_with_options, and enforce index_bytes.saturating_add(max_sample_size) <= mem_limit.

entries.title: Align Y4M lossless overlay frame working-set check, guarded frame cloning, and FFV1 packet budget diagnostics between plan_transcode_lossless and transcode_lossless
entries.before: transcode_lossless checked overlay Y4M frame_len > limit without adding meta_working_bytes (whereas plan_transcode_lossless charged frame_len + meta_working_bytes), plan_transcode_lossless cloned the first frame with unguarded data.to_vec(), and write_y4m_ffv1_policy reported 'Y4M FFV1 working set exceeds controlled memory budget' instead of 'encoded FFV1 packet exceeds controlled memory budget'.
entries.result: Charge frame_len.saturating_add(meta_working_bytes) for Y4M overlays in transcode_lossless, allocate the first-frame clone via owned_frame::buffer in plan_transcode_lossless, and align the post-encode FFV1 packet budget error message in write_y4m_ffv1_policy.

entries.title: Reject existing outputs upfront and defer 0-packet progress until preflight succeeds in native and owned WAVE PCM audio exports
entries.before: export_pcm_selected opened and decoded the audio source before checking if destination already existed and emitted a 0-packet ProgressEvent before validating sample rate, channels, metadata, or controlled memory budgets; owned_audio_export::decode_audio_transformed similarly emitted a 0-packet ProgressEvent before WAVE max_controlled_bytes admission.
entries.result: Check destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() upfront in export_pcm_selected and defer the initial 0-packet ProgressEvent in both export_pcm_selected and owned_audio_export::decode_audio_transformed until all preflight and controlled memory budget checks succeed.

entries.title: Enforce concatenated chapter limit, preserve MP4 track preferences, and check destination upfront in MP4-to-Matroska concat
entries.before: mp4_concat::open_with_options did not check whether total chapters across concatenated MP4 segments exceeded Matroska's 1024-chapter cap or charge source track name/language bytes in raw_meta_bytes, mp4_concat::write_with_options dropped MP4 track enabled/default flags by calling PacketWriter::new_with_text_metadata instead of PacketWriter::new_with_track_preferences, and try_concat_mp4_matroska_with_options scanned all source MP4 segments before checking if destination already existed.
entries.result: Enforce total_chapters <= 1024 and charge selected source track name/language bytes in mp4_concat::open_with_options, preserve MP4 track enabled/default preferences via PacketWriter::new_with_track_preferences in mp4_concat::write_with_options, and reject existing Matroska concat destinations upfront in try_concat_mp4_matroska_with_options.

entries.title: Reject existing destinations upfront before opening or scanning inputs in owned and native Matroska remux and FFV1 export
entries.before: owned_mp4_remux::remux scanned the source MP4 twice (in supports and open/validate_selected_prefix_packet_budget) before owned_matroska_remux::publish checked destination.symlink_metadata(), and remux_mp4_matroska_inner, transcode_ffv1_selected, remux_matroska_with_packet_and_memory_limits, and remux_mp4_stats_with_memory_limit opened/transcoded inputs and reserved temporary files before failing at std::fs::hard_link when destination already existed.
entries.result: Check destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() upfront before opening or scanning inputs in owned_mp4_remux::remux, remux_mp4_matroska_inner, transcode_ffv1_selected, remux_matroska_with_packet_and_memory_limits, and remux_mp4_stats_with_memory_limit.

entries.title: Check destination and broken symlinks upfront before scanning inputs and use fallible buffers in mix, merge, and concat audio
entries.before: mix_audio_with_controls, merge_audio_with_controls, and concat_audio_with_options used destination.try_exists() instead of destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() (missing broken symlinks at destination until std::fs::hard_link after decoding all inputs), merge_audio_with_controls and concat_audio_with_options scanned all inputs before checking destination extension or existence, and mix/merge allocated sample block buffers with infallible vec![0; ...].
entries.result: Validate destination extension and destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() before scanning inputs in mix_audio_with_controls, merge_audio_with_controls, and concat_audio_with_options, and allocate mix/merge sample block buffers with fallible crate::buffer / try_reserve_exact.

entries.title: Enforce 256-tag Matroska container and stream metadata caps and fallback probe metadata memory budget in pcm_matroska
entries.before: parse_matroska_pcm_metadata did not check text.len() <= 256 or scoped.values().all(|m| m.len() <= 256), allowing plan_loudnorm, plan_mix, plan_merge, and plan_concat to accept >256 combined source and user tags that later failed in PacketWriter::new_with_text_metadata; additionally, the fallback probe branch in extract_source_pcm_metadata_with_interval_packet_and_memory_limit did not check max_controlled_bytes on extracted tags.
entries.result: Enforce text.len() <= 256 and per-stream scoped tag count <= 256 in parse_matroska_pcm_metadata and enforce max_controlled_bytes on fallback container metadata in extract_source_pcm_metadata_with_interval_packet_and_memory_limit.

entries.title: Charge simultaneous index and packet working set in validate_encoded_audio_packet_budget for MP4 and Matroska audio planning
entries.before: validate_encoded_audio_packet_budget checked index_bytes > mem_limit and packet_size > max_packet_bytes independently for MP4 and Matroska sources, allowing plan_decode_audio to admit inputs whose simultaneous index_bytes + sample_size (MP4) or index_bytes + packet_payload_size + packet_read_overhead (Matroska) exceeded max_controlled_bytes.
entries.result: Charge index_bytes.saturating_add(max_sample_bytes) for MP4 and index_bytes.saturating_add(pkt_bytes).saturating_add(overhead) for Matroska against max_controlled_bytes in validate_encoded_audio_packet_budget.

entries.title: Reject existing destinations upfront and eliminate redundant intermediate Vec<f32> allocations in owned audio mix and merge
entries.before: media::mix_audio_with_controls and media::merge_audio_with_controls probed all sources in native_audio_mix::eligible_with_options before checking if destination already existed, owned_audio_mix::mix_with_controls_and_decoder and merge_with_controls_and_decoder decoded all inputs in worker threads before write_wav_f32le checked destination.symlink_metadata(), and merge_with_controls_and_decoder allocated two full intermediate Vec<f32> buffers with infallible .collect() in addition to out.
entries.result: Check destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() upfront in media::mix_audio_with_controls, media::merge_audio_with_controls, and owned_audio_mix mix/merge, and populate the fallibly reserved merge output buffer directly from decoded PCM byte slices.

entries.title: Reject existing destinations upfront before pass-1 measurement or WAVE processing and use fallibly reserved block buffers in loudnorm and normalize-loudness
entries.before: owned_loudnorm::apply_resolved and apply_dynamic read the source WAVE, emitted progress events, and ran resampling/dynamic normalization before write_wav_f32le_with_side_data_checked checked destination.symlink_metadata(); apply_dynamic allocated per-block Vec<u8> and Vec<f64> buffers with infallible Vec::with_capacity / .collect(); native_loudnorm::try_apply checked destination.exists() (missing broken symlinks) only after scanning inputs; and normalize_file_with_options ran pass-1 loudness measurement before checking if destination existed.
entries.result: Check destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() upfront in owned_loudnorm::apply_resolved, apply_dynamic, native_loudnorm::try_apply, and normalize_file_with_options before any input scan or progress emission, and reuse fallibly reserved block scratch buffers in apply_dynamic.

entries.title: Defer 0-packet WAVE loudness progress until preflight and use fallible allocations in measure_for_normalization and LoudnessMeter::new
entries.before: owned_wave_loudness::measure_for_normalization emitted a 0-packet ProgressEvent before check(options) and allocated buffer and pcm with infallible vec! and Vec::with_capacity, and LoudnessMeter::new allocated its 3-second short_ring and 0.4-second ring buffers with infallible vec![0.0; ...].
entries.result: Check options and allocate buffer and pcm via owned_frame::buffer and try_reserve_exact before emitting initial progress in measure_for_normalization, and use fallible try_reserve_exact for short_ring, ring, and weights in LoudnessMeter::new.

entries.title: Reject existing subtitle destinations upfront before reading inputs and use fallible source buffers in ASS and SRT conversion
entries.before: try_convert_matroska_inner, try_convert_ass_inner, and try_convert_srt_inner read and parsed the entire subtitle input and wrote a temporary Matroska file before failing at std::fs::hard_link when destination already existed, and try_convert_ass_inner / try_convert_srt_inner read up to 64 MiB into an unreserved Vec::new().
entries.result: Check !dry_run && destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() upfront in try_convert_matroska_inner, try_convert_ass_inner, try_convert_srt_inner, and publish_events_with_metadata, and pre-reserve ASS/SRT input buffers via try_reserve_exact.

entries.title: Reject existing destinations upfront in native WAVE trim/concat, native and owned ADTS remux/concat, and owned WAVE audio export
entries.before: native_pcm::trim_wave, concat_wave, and write_wave inspected inputs and wrote temporary WAVE files before failing at std::fs::hard_link when destination existed; native_export::remux_adts_aac_with_options, concat_adts_aac_with_options, and publish_adts_readers_limited opened ADTS inputs and muxed temporary outputs before checking destination; and owned_adts_remux::remux, owned_concat::concat, and owned_audio_export::decode_audio_transformed opened or read inputs before checking destination.symlink_metadata().
entries.result: Check destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() upfront before opening or reading inputs in native_pcm::trim_wave, concat_wave, write_wave, native_export ADTS remux/concat, owned_adts_remux::remux, owned_concat::concat, and owned_audio_export::decode_audio_transformed.

entries.title: Reject existing destinations before container recognition and use fallible allocations in decode_audio_transformed
entries.before: decode_audio_transformed ran up to 11 container recognizes/coding probes (opening and indexing Matroska, MP4, and Ogg files) before checking destination.symlink_metadata(), allocated per-block normalized buffers with infallible Vec::with_capacity inside the loop, and built final output sample buffers with infallible Vec::with_capacity / .collect().
entries.result: Check destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() upfront right after the .wav extension check in decode_audio_transformed, reuse a single fallibly reserved normalized block buffer outside the loop, and pre-reserve output sample buffers with try_reserve_exact.

entries.title: Use fallible buffers and reusable packet scratch in G.711 WAVE and Ogg Vorbis/joint audio exports
entries.before: owned_g711_wave_export::decode allocated input bytes with infallible vec! and allocated a new output Vec<u8> per packet with .collect(); owned_ogg_audio_export::select_backend, owned_ogg_vorbis_export::open_with_transform, and owned_ogg_joint_export::open_with_transform read the entire Ogg file into an unreserved Vec::new(); and Vorbis/joint decode allocated silence and packet buffers with infallible vec! / .collect().
entries.result: Use owned_frame::buffer and try_reserve_exact for G.711 packet input/output scratch buffers, pre-reserve limits.file_bytes in Ogg backend selection and Vorbis/joint open_with_transform, and use fallible buffers in Vorbis and joint decode.

entries.title: Eliminate redundant full-file re-reads for WAVE metadata in raw FLAC and MP3 export and audio planning
entries.before: owned_raw_flac::apply, owned_raw_mp3::apply, and owned_audio_plan::source_descriptor_for_decode called source_info(source, options) in addition to open_with_transform / descriptor_for_decode, reading and parsing the entire raw FLAC or MP3 file from disk a second time just to extract WAVE INFO metadata.
entries.result: Extract WAVE INFO metadata directly from the already-parsed Flac / Mp3 structure via source_info_from_parsed in apply and validate descriptor info_len in source_descriptor_for_decode without re-reading the file.

entries.title: Reject invalid args, non-.wav extensions, and existing destinations before policy checks in container and ADTS loudnorm
entries.before: owned_container_loudnorm::apply and owned_adts_loudnorm::apply checked stream/metadata policies before validating loudnorm args, .wav output extension, and destination.symlink_metadata(), returning stream/metadata errors instead of rejecting an existing destination first.
entries.result: Validate loudnorm args, .wav extension, and destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() upfront before checking stream/metadata policies in owned_container_loudnorm::apply and owned_adts_loudnorm::apply.

entries.title: Use fallible Vec<u8> output reservation in float32 and float64 streaming resamplers
entries.before: owned_resample::Resampler and owned_resample_f64::Resampler checked try_reserve(1) on their internal history VecDeque, but wrote resampled output bytes into Vec<u8> via std::io::Write::write_all, which uses infallible reserve and aborts on OOM.
entries.result: Introduce ResamplerOutput with fallible try_reserve for Vec<u8> outputs and use write_sample_bytes in both float32 and float64 Resampler implementations.

entries.title: Use fallible try_reserve_exact and single-pass inline finiteness validation in PcmDecoder::decode_pcm and decode_pcm_f64
entries.before: PcmDecoder::decode_pcm and PcmDecoder::decode_pcm_f64 allocated Vec<f32> and Vec<f64> via infallible .collect() and then iterated over the entire decoded sample slice a second time to check !s.is_finite().
entries.result: Pre-reserve exact sample capacity via try_reserve_exact and validate !sample.is_finite() inline in a single loop in both decode_pcm and decode_pcm_f64.

entries.title: Use checked arithmetic and fallible try_reserve_exact for planar and interleaved output buffers in owned and playback MACE decoders
entries.before: MaceDecoder::decode_planar always allocated two Vec::with_capacity(blocks * SAMPLES_PER_BLOCK) buffers even for mono streams, and MaceDecoder::decode_pcm and AudioDecode::decode_encoded used infallible Vec::with_capacity with unchecked multiplication.
entries.result: Use checked_mul and fallible try_reserve_exact only for active channels in decode_planar and for interleaved output buffers in decode_pcm and decode_encoded.

entries.title: Pre-reserve packet position table with try_reserve_exact in owned_webm_audio_window::apply
entries.before: owned_webm_audio_window::apply checked the controlled memory budget for positions_bytes, but allocated positions with infallible Vec::with_capacity(indices.len()).
entries.result: Allocate positions with fallible try_reserve_exact(indices.len()) in owned_webm_audio_window::apply.

entries.title: Check .mkv extension and existing destination upfront before opening or decoding input video in owned_webm_multitrack_export::try_export
entries.before: owned_webm_multitrack_export::try_export ran qualify(source, t, o) and decoded the entire input video via decode_webm(source, &request, None, Some(o)) before checking that destination had a .mkv extension and did not already exist.
entries.result: Validate destination .mkv extension and destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() at the very start of owned_webm_multitrack_export::try_export before opening or decoding source.

entries.title: Precompute schedule_base_bytes once outside the packet loop and attribute memory-budget-clamped packet rejections in owned_mp4_multitrack_export
entries.before: owned_mp4_multitrack_export::try_export recomputed plan_bytes across all audio plans and called video.estimated_index_payload_bytes() inside the inner loop on every output packet, and qualify reported 'MP4 packet exceeds budget' instead of 'controlled memory budget exceeded: MP4 index and metadata' when a packet fit max_packet_bytes but exceeded max_controlled_bytes - index_and_meta_bytes.
entries.result: Precompute plan_bytes, video_index_bytes, and schedule_base_bytes once before the packet loop in try_export, and report 'controlled memory budget exceeded: MP4 index and metadata' when effective_packet_limit is clamped below max_packet_bytes by max_controlled_bytes.

entries.title: Pre-reserve stream and chapter lists with try_reserve_exact in owned_webm_probe::try_probe_webm_with_limits
entries.before: try_probe_webm_with_limits allocated streams and chapters with Vec::new() and pushed reader.tracks.len() and reader.chapters.len() entries via infallible growth.
entries.result: Pre-reserve streams and chapters with fallible try_reserve_exact(reader.tracks.len()) and try_reserve_exact(reader.chapters.len()) in try_probe_webm_with_limits.

entries.title: Read and parse the primary Y4M header once per call in owned_y4m_decode::supports_transformed
entries.before: supports_transformed opened source and parsed the Y4M header up to 5 separate times across header_format, overlay_supported, supports, framestep_clock_supported, and transpose header_format.
entries.result: Read and parse Header once via read_header(source) in supports_transformed and pass &header to overlay_supported_with_header and framestep_clock_supported_with_header.

entries.title: Reuse the already-opened reader and header buffer in owned_y4m_probe::try_y4m_with_options
entries.before: try_y4m_with_options opened source, verified the YUV4MPEG2 signature, read and validated the header line, and then called probe_y4m_with_options(source, options), which re-opened source, re-validated options, and re-read the header line.
entries.result: Extract probe_y4m_after_header(source, input, line, options) and call it directly from try_y4m_with_options and probe_y4m_with_options without re-opening source or re-reading the header line.

entries.title: Use fallible frame buffer allocation in owned_ffv1_encoder::encode_y4m_counted
entries.before: encode_y4m_counted cloned each decoded Y4M frame into GeometryFrame using infallible data.to_vec() before encoding FFV1.
entries.result: Allocate GeometryFrame::data via fallible crate::owned_frame::buffer(data.len()) in encode_y4m_counted.

entries.title: Reject existing destination upfront in owned_lossless::transcode_lossless before transform and container validation
entries.before: transcode_lossless checked the .mkv extension upfront, but deferred destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() until individual export backends or after transform, metadata, MP4 bridge staging, and Y4M header/frame-size budget checks.
entries.result: Check destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok() immediately after the .mkv extension check in transcode_lossless before transform validation, bridge staging, or container probing.

entries.title: Use fallible buffer and try_reserve_exact allocations in WAVE and Ogg probe paths
entries.before: probe_wave_with_options allocated each WAVE INFO entry via infallible vec![0; entry_bytes], and probe_ogg_with_options allocated the Ogg file buffer and stream list via infallible Vec::with_capacity.
entries.result: Allocate WAVE INFO entry buffers via crate::owned_frame::buffer and pre-reserve Ogg probe file bytes and stream lists via fallible try_reserve_exact.

entries.title: Pre-reserve stream and chapter lists with try_reserve_exact in owned_mp4_probe::try_mp4_with_options
entries.before: try_mp4_with_options allocated streams with Vec::new() without pre-reserving reader.tracks().len() and collected chapters via infallible .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>().
entries.result: Pre-reserve streams and chapters with fallible try_reserve_exact(reader.tracks().len()) and try_reserve_exact(reader.chapters().len()) in try_mp4_with_options.

entries.title: Reject existing destinations upfront before supports() in owned_matroska_remux::remux and owned_concat::concat and use fallible reader reservation
entries.before: owned_matroska_remux::remux and owned_concat::concat called supports() (which opens source files and checks policies) before checking whether destination already existed, and open_readers in owned_concat allocated readers with infallible Vec::with_capacity.
entries.result: Check destination existence before supports() in owned_matroska_remux::remux and owned_concat::concat, and use try_reserve_exact(sources.len()) in open_readers.

entries.title: Reject existing destinations and non-.wav extensions upfront in owned_wave_remux and pre-reserve segment descriptors with try_reserve_exact
entries.before: owned_wave_remux::copy_waves checked interval and policies(options) before checking .wav extension and existing destination, trim and concat opened or checked sources before checking destination, and copy_waves allocated segments with infallible Vec::with_capacity.
entries.result: Check .wav extension and existing destination at the start of copy_waves, trim, and concat, and pre-reserve segments via try_reserve_exact(sources.len()).

entries.title: Reuse already-opened and parsed Flac and Mp3 structures during spooled WAVE exports in owned_raw_flac::apply and owned_raw_mp3::apply
entries.before: owned_raw_flac::apply and owned_raw_mp3::apply opened, read, and parsed the entire FLAC or MP3 file into memory via open_with_transform, and then called decode_raw_flac_pcm / decode_raw_mpeg_pcm inside spool_decoded, which opened, read, and parsed the entire file a second time.
entries.result: Extract decode_raw_parsed(&parsed, file_bytes, ...) in owned_raw_flac and owned_raw_mp3 and invoke it directly from apply using the already-parsed Flac and Mp3 instances.

entries.title: Reuse the already-parsed Ogg container in owned_ogg_vorbis_export::open_with_transform without re-opening or re-reading source
entries.before: open_with_transform in owned_ogg_vorbis_export read the entire Ogg file into memory, parsed Ogg::parse(&bytes, &limits), dropped ogg, and then called Program::open_source_track, which opened source a second time and read and parsed the entire Ogg file again.
entries.result: Expose Program::from_ogg_source_track(ogg, selection) in owned_ogg_vorbis and call it directly from open_with_transform using the already-parsed Ogg instance.

entries.title: Pre-reserve Ogg file byte buffers with fallible try_reserve_exact in owned_ogg_opus::Program::open_selected and owned_ogg_vorbis::Program::read

entries.before: overlay_video_transformed called overlay_eligible(main) (which checked native_lossless_y4m::eligible(main)) and then called native_lossless_y4m::eligible(main) again before dispatching to write_processed or write_mp4_processed.
entries.result: Compute planar_eligible = crate::native_lossless_y4m::eligible(main)? once and reuse it to dispatch between write_processed and write_mp4_processed.

entries.title: Open source once in native_media::inspect_audio_source_selected instead of up to four times
entries.before: inspect_audio_source_selected called is_mp4_audio_container(source) (opening source), then native_export::is_matroska_source(source) (opening source again), then opened source a third time for the 4-byte prefix check, and for MP4 opened source a fourth time in Mp4Reader::open_indexed.
entries.result: Open BufReader::new(File::open(source)?) once, read the 8-byte prefix, seek back to 0, and pass input directly to WebmReader::open or Mp4Reader::open_indexed.

entries.title: Remove redundant is_mp4_audio_container and is_matroska_source pre-opens in native_media::is_owned_audio_source_with_interval_and_options
entries.before: is_owned_audio_source_with_interval_and_options opened path twice for is_mp4_audio_container and is_matroska_source before calling constant_audio_source_info_selected_with_interval_and_options, which already inspects the container prefix.
entries.result: Call constant_audio_source_info_selected_with_interval_and_options(path, None, interval, options).is_ok() directly after the AAC check.

entries.title: Combine MP4 and Matroska container prefix checks into a single File::open in native_media::is_owned_audio_trim_source_with_interval_and_options
entries.before: is_owned_audio_trim_source_with_interval_and_options called is_mp4_audio_container(path) and native_export::is_matroska_source(path) separately, opening path twice.
entries.result: Read the 8-byte prefix in one File::open(path) and check recognizes_prefix(&prefix) || prefix.starts_with(&[0x1a, 0x45, 0xdf, 0xa3]).

entries.title: Reuse a single File handle across is_wave_reader and native_pcm::inspect in native_loudnorm::try_plan
entries.before: native_loudnorm::try_plan called native_pcm::is_wave(source) (opening source) and then opened source a second time for native_pcm::inspect.

entries.title: Cache and reuse (selected, AudioSourceInfo) across admission and execution in native_loudnorm::try_apply
entries.before: native_loudnorm::try_apply called selected_audio(source, options) and constant_audio_source_info_selected_with_options(source, Some(idx), &default_opts) during native_supported admission and then called both functions a second time immediately afterwards.

entries.title: Cache planar_eligible in native_plan::transcode_lossless instead of calling native_lossless_y4m::eligible twice
entries.before: native_plan::transcode_lossless called native_lossless::eligible(source) (which called native_lossless_y4m::eligible(source)) and then called native_lossless_y4m::eligible(source) a second time to dispatch between validate_first_frame and validate_first_mp4_frame.
entries.result: Compute planar_eligible = crate::native_lossless_y4m::eligible(source)? once and reuse it to dispatch first-frame validation.

entries.title: Cache constant_audio_source_info_selected_with_options in native_plan::loudness_with_options

entries.title: Remove redundant foreground probe(foreground) calls in native_plan::overlay_with_geometry_and_filters and decode_overlay_with_geometry_and_filters
entries.before: overlay_with_geometry_and_filters and decode_overlay_with_geometry_and_filters called native_probe::probe(foreground) before calling TimedOverlay::validate_pair_with_geometry_and_filters, which immediately called Source::open(foreground) and ran native_probe::probe(foreground) a second time.

entries.title: Eliminate duplicate audio_stream_index_from_metadata and constant_audio_source_info_selected_with_interval_and_options calls in native_export::trim_audio_pcm_with_controls
entries.before: trim_audio_pcm_with_controls called is_aac_trim_source_with_interval_and_options and then called aac_trim_selection_with_interval_and_options or audio_trim_selection_with_interval_and_options, inspecting the container index and stream setup twice.

entries.title: Eliminate duplicate container inspection for non-AAC sources in native_plan::trim_audio_with_options
entries.before: native_plan::trim_audio_with_options called is_aac_trim_source_with_interval_and_options (which inspected constant_audio_source_info_selected_with_interval_and_options when selected.is_some()) and then called audio_trim_selection_with_interval_and_options which inspected it a second time.
entries.result: Resolve index via audio_stream_index_from_metadata and inspect constant_audio_source_info_selected_with_interval_and_options once before branching to trim_aac_with_options when info.codec == "aac".

entries.title: media::uses_native_audio_route single File::open across WAVE and MP4 prefix inspection
